publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The thesis made a brief summary of the development process of the user interface. through the some examples,describe the disappearance of sense of entities and the arrival of natural user interface, and focuses on the seven typical characteristics of the natural interface.

articleTitle: ECQFD & LCA based methodology for sustainable product design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Sustainable product design concerns economic, environmental and social impacts enacted through the product lifecycle. Majority of the manufacturers have realized the importance of sustainability, but there is not a effect method they can take into practice. This paper proposed a methodology which is based on the environmentally conscious quality function deployment (ECQFD) and product life cycle assessment (LCA) for the product designers. Environmental voice of customer, environmental engineering metrics, product life cycle cost and product effectiveness are involved in the method. The case study is conducted in an electronics switches factory, and the result of the implementation shows the effectiveness and worth of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on design of serious game based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Regarded as an revolution of future human competence development, serious game is rising in a wide range of fields like education, medicine, training, scenario simulation, publications, national defense and public-opinion poll, etc. During the production process of serious games, terrain data is a necessity and mainly made by artificiality. Some applications (like military training, fire-fighting exercises) call profound potential demands for real data. This paper puts up the principle of game design that integrates GIS engine with game engine, through which serious game can gain ability to query spatial information based on GIS functions. It is also discussed that how to apply existed GIS spatial data to serious game to make games more realistic.

articleTitle: A reversible watermarking scheme for 2D vector drawings based on difference expansion
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This paper proposed a reversible watermarking scheme for 2D vector drawings based on difference expansion DE. Few researches have been conducted on reversible watermarking method of 2D vector drawings till now. In our scheme, Information data including watermark is embedded into the nearest pairs of vertexes sequence in x-direction or in y-direction instead of the pairs of neighbouring vertexes, and as a result the capacity of watermark will be increased and shape distortions be reduced. The Hash value from the original drawings is also embedded as a part of watermark in order to exactly estimate the completeness of the extracted data. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed reversible watermarking algorithm can accurately separate and completely extract the watermark as well as host data. Generally it shows better performances than the previous ones.

articleTitle: The overview of 2D to 3D conversion system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: 3D signal processing has become a hot trend in the related visual processing field. But at this stage, the lack of 3D content is becoming an important factor that limits its development. It will be great help to solve this problem if we extract the depth information from the monocular image and automatically convert it to 3D video. An automatic 2D-to-3D conversion will greatly reduce the production cost, while providing a richer and higher quality 3D content. On the basis of some research findings in recent years, this paper will introduce the main two kinds of methods to do the conversion: off-line conversion and real-time conversion. Taking off-line conversion for example, we systematically presents all aspects of the conversion process, including the various methods that each aspect can use, then we describe the principles and basic methods for real-time conversion, and finally discuss the challenge and development that 2D to 3D image conversion technology will be in the future.

articleTitle: Real-time cloth simulation based on improved Verlet algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Physical model and numerical solver are the basis of current cloth simulation engines. Currently, research in cloth animation has focused on improving realism as well as computation speed. In this paper we present an improved Verlet algorithm which enhances the capabilities of initial one in three aspects. The first one is using 2-level Taylor series as the startup method. The second one is using a more simplified way to obtain the velocity of the particle through approximate substitution. The third one is using Beeman algorithm when the change of force is greater than the threshold value. The experiment results indicate that this approach is efficient and accurate, and can be used in real-time cloth simulation system.

articleTitle: Exploring Virtual Display Design based on 3DSMAX and VR-Platform
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the arrival of the era of digital, the Virtual Reality Technology (VRT) has brought display design an abroad development space. This paper explores mainly the technology and process of Virtual Display Design (VDD) based on 3DSMAX and VR-Platform (VRP), and also introduces the connotation, new concept and implementation of VDD in order to make designer not only attach importance to the value of VDD in commercial economy but also use it better in the social practice.

articleTitle: Humanization design and harmonization design in product designing
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The diversified market of products, brought up nowadays more and more requirements for designing, and the designs reflect the development of a society. To make a good design, one must consider various elements and factors comprehensively and make good use of them, and take market demands as the criterion. Humanization design and harmonization design should be evaluated by the people who accept the service.

articleTitle: The application of CBIR-based system for the product in electronic retailing
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The appearance and popularization of the computer makes the global e-commerce overwhelming tide. CBIR-based system has been used in all kinds of applications, however, the system is seldom applied to the aspect of clothing electronic retailing. The paper describes a method for enhancing the search and retrieval of product information, discussing content-based image retrieval in the application of clothing electronic retailing. Using color and texture matching techniques, the article introduces the application of CBIR software in electronic retailing. From a new perspective of application module, we describe the collocation system of men's shirts, and achieve the purpose of computer-assisted sales. At last, come to the conclusion: designers can not only express visual information convenient under the invisible conditions using this system, but also can be used in the supply-chain management, as well as plan the research direction of this system in the future. It shows considerable application value for the development of clothing electronic retailing.

articleTitle: Application of bionic design in product form design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Nature is a talented designer. She makes every natural form existing in the world has own clever and unique shape, color, texture, structure and function. In product form design, using bionic principle, the research and application of natural biological form are carried out. Based on concrete or abstract bionic means, by extracting, simplifying evolving the form features of researched object, design inspiration and creative thinking of designer is triggered. Fully exerting the designers' creative imagination to product form will make the product form design has vigor and the emotion. and performs simulating natural beauty, so greatly improve the product value.

articleTitle: A electromechanical parts library for 3D-MID design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The new requirements of the CAD system for cross-domain mechatronic design especially 3D-MID design lead to an expansion of the information capacity for the development of an electronic parts library. In this paper, a methodology of creating a electronic/mechanical integrated, cross-domain, three-dimensional parts library for the design of Molded Interconnect Devices (3D-MID) is presented. This library is developed based on multiple views, 3D geometry modeling and STEP AP210 techniques to support not only the description of electronic information, but also the description of mechanical information. The library which is applied in the MIDCAD system can provide a remarkably improved support for an efficient design of complex 3D-MID products.

articleTitle: Research on the cultivation mode of digital visual effects talents
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Recent years have witnessed the rapid development of digital effects in the fields of film and television, advertising, games, etc. and a sudden increase in the demand for talents, which has put forward new requirements for the cultivation mode of talents in the field of digital effects. This article discusses how to transform the present single teaching method into a new cultivation mode which can better meet the requirements, and proposes to combine the disciplines of arts and technology to cultivate high-level interdisciplinary digital effects talents.

articleTitle: Research on computer aided machine tool color design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: To remedy the deficiency of current machine tool color design tools, a new method of computer aided color design is proposed in order to enhance the efficiency of machine tool industrial design. New method includes: color selecting based on color harmony and color endowing based on mapping relationship. A prototype system was developed based on the research with a case of machine tool color design as example.

articleTitle: Green design - Studies about fashion handbag
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Manufacturing fashion products enormously discharge industrial waste due to the high ratio of inventory turnover, constant change in trend, small quantity batch production, and so on. With understanding of the important association between design and environment, researches on sustainable design such as eco-design, environmental design, and green design are getting more highlighted. Given that circumstances, green design of female handbag is discussed in this study. As a methodology, it is done to refer to literatures on trends of green fashion design and purses, and as a result, it is found that green qualities of the fashion products are prominently embedded in materials and design. For the material for green design, leather, the primary material of purse, is used. In the manufacturing process, tannin extracted from vegetables is chosen to reduce environmental pollution. For the design, convertible purses based on simple and multi-functional design was tried. It was shown that a variety of application would make it possible to develop more other design.

articleTitle: Mobile phone UI design principles in the design of human-machine interaction design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This paper based on the principle of mobile UI design, expounds that only little input on beautiful and easily use of design, it will have great output. In conclusion, based on the control of mobile phone's interface design standardization, can achieve very good people and interaction effect, the experience of mobile phone users are more higher satisfaction to the complementary products will have greatly increase value.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality for Arts and Design education
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the development of network technology and multimedia technology, Virtual Reality makes multimedia information more effective in idea presentation. At the same time it helps users perceive products styling and evaluate products prototype. On the basis of the constructing VR system in design and arts, this paper demonstrates concepts and methods of Virtual Reality, meanwhile talks about the problems in the nowadays situation. In the end the paper gives my opinion upon the future direction of the virtual reality application in design and arts.

articleTitle: Culture-adapted user interface design method for mobile phone: Correlation between user knowledge and icon
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This study is to explore the design process regarding how interface designers in China deal with the user interface design styles pertinent to the mobile phone, and investigates correlation between user knowledge and icon of mobile phone. An experiment was conducted to examine the usability and user's satisfaction of the designed mobile phone UI. Sixteen Chinese participants in China participated in this study. User knowledge eliciting and interface usability testing were conducted to study correlation between user knowledge and icon. Results indicate that culture-adapted user interface design method for mobile phone can help designers to develop appropriate user interface for Chinese users.

articleTitle: Structural analysis and topology optimization design for a sweeper vehicle frame
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: To improve the mechanical performance and reduce the weight of a sweeper vehicle frame, a finite element model for a dump sweeper vehicle frame is established to analyze strength stiffness and modal of vehicle. By using Ls-dyna software, displacement and time curve for vehicle rectangular frame under external force incentives is solved. Based on the analysis results, topological optimization is carried out to reduce the use of material and improve the stiffness and dynamic characters of the frame. Optimization results show that static strength of vehicle frame satisfies working requirements, the rough road and idling speed will not make the frame resonate.

articleTitle: A product form design study based on semiotics
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: According to the semiotics explanation, the main function of the symbols is to convey message, if we consider a product's form, materials, colors and other factors as the basic symbol to study, they also convey messages to the users. This paper discusses the structure and functions of product form symbols, and provides some practical design cases as references.

articleTitle: The analysis and application of associative element-combining configuration of Dongba Characters
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In the light of the internal configuration pattern of Dongba Characters, this paper proposed the concept of “graph element”. Based on the concept of “graph element”, the author explained associative element-combining configuration of Dongba Characters, and analyzed the use of graph and meaning and the 3 major features, which are position, color and size ratio, in both homo-graph element and hetero-graph element configuration of associative element-combining characters. The use of Dongba Character as basic element in design and application of these configuration patterns, ideas and expressions into brand image advertising design can enrich both the information content and the visual connotation it expresses.

articleTitle: The humanistic requirements for children food packaging
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The children growing in the new economic environment are care-free about feeding and clothing. The modern living and thinking have brought about various changes to children's needs. The children's food is particularly the parents' most concern. Therefore, besides the safety and convenience of the previous concern, the children food packaging should more value the children's psychological needs and humanistic care in terms of the material, structure, colour, interest and entertainment. Today's children food packaging is colourful and taking on various forms. Improving the children food packaging in colour, structure, and outlook to meet children's needs, to arouse children's desire to purchase and to propel the parents to complete the purchase will promote the sales.

articleTitle: Automatic measurement of scanned human body in fixed posture
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Clothing customization needs dimensional data of human body. The 3D scanner can only get the surface data, which usually consists of a great many points and triangles. Measurement of the scanned human body automatically is a very complicated problem in practical applications. This paper proposed a simple but rapid method for automatic measurement of scanned human body in fixed posture. We slice the body surface into many paralleled intersections from which we can detect the landmarks that segmentation needs. In every subsection, we continue to extract more detail landmarks for the circumference and the length measurement. We present experimental results to verify our methods are efficient in processing different body data.

articleTitle: Application of Virtual Reality Technology in environment art design teaching
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Currently, virtual reality technology as an increasingly sophisticated computer technology has great significance in the environmental art design. This article will give some basic knowledge and views to discuss the “Virtual Reality Technology” features, the advantages of environment art design and the application of education.

articleTitle: The direction of footwear computer-aided design in China
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: China is the bigest footwear producer and exporter in the world, however, the computer-aided design not widespread use in the shoe industry, most footwear enterprise still rely on artificial operation to complete the design works. Based on the characteristics of shoes industry and footwear design software, and the status quo of the market environment, this paper will try to find out the direction of footwear computer-aided design software development, especially in china.

articleTitle: Study on the rapid design techniques of crystal lighting
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The paper discusses the techniques of rapid crystal lighting modeling using CAD technology with regard to the complex characteristics of the outlook of crystal lighting. The crystal lighting is divided into linear distribution, area distribution and the volume distribution according to its monomer characteristic. We develop the aiding designing software based on the Rhinoceros. The software can compute the distribution of the crystal lighting entity selected by the user and automatically generate the model of crystal lighting consistent with the specified distribution. Such technology greatly improves the efficiency of crystal lighting designers.

articleTitle: The comparison of user-centered design and goal-directed design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Nowadays with the economic growth, more and more problems made the transformation of economic growth be the key. User-centered design is a way of thinking method present in Research stage of the goal-directed design, and it has a vital role in the comprehensive understanding of the user. Goal-directed design is a comprehensive design approach that emphasizes the guide of design. This article tries to compare two design concepts and explore the benefits of economic growth mode transformation of the design guidelines for the healthy development of social and economic assistance.

articleTitle: Ergonomic evaluation and design of the VDT system for the hermetic cockpit
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This paper presents a closed-loop design method which has been utilized to evaluate and design the Visual Display Terminal (VDT) system of the hermetic cockpit. Our evaluation steps include: 1) we propose five ergonomic factors of the VDT system, i.e., the Observation Distance (OD), the Illumination Level (IL), the Observation Angle (OA), the Size of the Observation Target (SOT), and the Background Contrast (BC) to evaluate the ergonomic performance of it. 2) We evaluate the importance level of these factors above by an orthogonal experiment method. 3) We use the result of the orthogonal experiment to improve the design of the VDT system. 4) We utilize an eye-hand harmony experiment (an exterior experiment, different to the evaluation experiment in step 2)) to give a feedback and assess the validity of the improvement effect of the VDT system. Experiment results show that the important order of the effect factors in our experiment condition is: the OD, the IL, the SOT, the BC and the OA; and we also find that by using the evaluation result above, we can improve the working efficiency effectively by the test of the eye-hand harmony experiment.

articleTitle: Preliminary analysis of static marking guide system of high-speed rail
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: From 2010 to 2014, the construction of Chinese high-speed rail will enter an all-round harvest period. At present, China has put total 6,920 km of high-speed rail into operation and had more than 10,000 km of express highways under construction, ranking on the top in operation mileage in the world. Construction, completion and operation of high-speed rail will significantly influence the regional economy and industrial structure of China in the future. Static marking guide system of high-speed rail, as direct window of passenger service, guarantees the effective guide for passengers and embodies high quality and individualized service of high-speed rail. Static marking guide system complies with overall, systematic, standard, reasonable and scientific design concept, organizes and manages railway space order through planning and point arrangement and by means of graph, symbol, word, color and others, and effectively conveys information to passengers in a scientific way to help passengers acquire information in a more convenient and express way and arrive at the final destination accurately.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent transmitter for pulp consistency based on the CAN bus technology
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With its direction to decentralization, network and intelligence, field bus control system based on CAN has been applied more and more widely to the industrial control field. Aimed at solving the problems in the controlling process of pulp concentration based on analog instruments such as low precision and stability, high power consumption and excessive maintenance cost, an intelligent transmitter with CAN bus communication function is proposed here for pulp consistency control system. It can measure temperature, pressure and differential pressure signals. Methods to design the hardware and software of the transmitter are particular introduced. The hardware comprises industrial PC, single-chip MSC1211Y5, controller SJA1000 CAN and transceiver 82C250 CAN, which can realize the detection, conversion, calculation and communication of pulp concentration parameters. A main routine and a sending/receiving subroutine flow diagram on CAN communication are given in the paper. The system has features of simple structure, good applicability, low energy consumption, high reliability and strong anti-jamming ability and other advantages.

articleTitle: The optimal choice of computer-aided design software in modern industrial design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This article is discussing in how to optimize a suitable computer aided industrial design software, from the follow three aspect, industrial design students, design company and manufacturers, product type. And conclusing that the key to learning software, “not much, but in essence.“ A good designer should be master one software of every type of software. In accordance with their own strengths, interests, characteristics of positions, and needs of company or industry to focus on learning one type of software., aim to achieve “proficient one, master one, grasp one ”. So using different types of software in different stages to improve design efficiency.

articleTitle: Application of two-order particle swarm optimization algorithm in image segmentation
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The two-order particle swarm optimization algorithm was presented by Hu Jianxiu and Zeng Jianchao in 2007. The standard particle swarm optimization algorithm and the two-order particle swarm optimization algorithm are studied in the paper. This paper uses the modified two-order particle swarm optimization algorithm to carry out multi-threshold image segmentation. The experimental results show that the multi-threshold image segmentation method based on the modified two-order particle swarm optimization algorithm could segment the image effectively.

articleTitle: Study on modern design education based on the development of the creative industries
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the high knowledge-intensive, high value-added, and high integration, the creative industries have many characteristics. It has great improvement for improving the level of industrial development and optimizing industrial structure. Thus in the development of the creative industries, the education for the design was changed to match. It transfers from traditional education to modern design education which paid more attention to creative spirit, and its mission is to develop and bring up creative talents of good quality.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A study on the development of Beijing cultural and creative industries and their talent cultivation model
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Ride comfort research of off-road vehicle based on soft terrain
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The virtual prototype model of an off-road vehicle was built based on ADAMS software and the user-written subroutine for calculating interaction force between elastic tire and soft soil is set up according to the load-sinkage theory. The non-linear contact simulation between elastic tire and soft soil was implemented successfully by using ADAMS software. The soft soil land can be adjustable by changing the soil related parameters, off-road vehicle dynamic was simulated on the random input running test. The simulation result shows that the body acceleration suspension dynamic deformation and tire dynamic load of the vehicle are all changed and the displacement of body in z-direction increases obviously as terrain deformation increases. The result also shows that the suspension adapted to the hard ground is not necessarily adapted to the soft soil road. This model can accurately simulation the soft soil road deformation as the impact of vehicle ride.

articleTitle: Furniture creative evolution and design innovation factor
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Furniture regard as people everyday appliance, it reflected human survival state and methods, it reflected various times and nationalities of esthetic idea and appeal, bearing the different manners and religious belief. The furniture design research has to have a foothold on the furniture history culture of our country, dig out the design essence of ancient furniture from the Chinese traditional furniture, and propose creative elements of modern furniture design, to provide the basis for the innovative design of furniture.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A study on the development of experiential tourism souvenirs
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Design of controller panel based on ergonomics
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Based on the ergonomic theories, this paper analyzes the function and the technical index of a membrane panel, and presents its functional layout. Based on visual transmission theory, this paper analyzes the characters and symbols, colors, buttons, display window and decoration of a membrane panel. Taking physiological factors such as touch and vision into comprehensive consideration and taking a membrane panel design of an evacuation device for example, the paper demonstrates rational layout, beautiful visual appearance, man-machine coordinated design, and then evaluates the scheme by using fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), and attains the scheme meeting the demand, therefore improve efficiency of producing new products.

articleTitle: Structure design and product design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In the paper, structure is categorized into three kinds firstly: external structure, internal structure and system structure. Secondly, it is given that there is a common development of structure design and product design based on the theory of the three levels of design. Then we list the factors that affect the product design, such as material factor, process factor and environmental factor. Examples are enumerated to verify the views we presented.

articleTitle: Research on visual elements of Web UI design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the rising of people's aesthetic requirements, visual design is becoming the important factor of Web page user interface to success. Starting from the visual elements of Web UI design, this paper analyzes the function of component elements of webpage interface, and investigates the positioning and application of three essentials of vision design rules: visual focus, visual processes and visual space, in web page interface design, which provide useful reference for designers.

articleTitle: A brief analysis on the trend of modern household socket design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the increase of human material living standards, the socket design begins to draw more and more people's attention. This thesis uses the research method of typical cases analysis, analyzing and summarizing the development trend of modern household socket design from interest, deformability, specificity and integration, these four aspects. The purpose of this thesis is in order to solve the limitations on function and environmental incompatibility of ordinary sockets, and provide a thought for the socket design industry of our country.

articleTitle: Fuzzy-PID control in electro-hydraulic proportional valve system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In order to improve non-linear and time variation of electro-hydraulic proportional valve system, the structure work principle are briefly presented, fuzzy-PID control strategy is put forward by the application of fuzzy theory and fuzzy-PID controller is designed, the open-loop simulation is done, the results show fuzzy-PID control strategy which meet preferably the controlled demands, is good real-time performance, fast response, small overshoot

articleTitle: Aesthetic user experience and apparent space dimensions
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: By the experiment, this study explores the user experience's key component, the users' aesthetic reaction (UAR). The results show that: (1) interface's UAR is made up of beauty of impression (BI), hominine beauty (HB) and beauty of material (BM); (2) BI is the strongest at the three apparent space dimensions, and can be weaken by reducing dimensions; (3) HB and BM are the best at the two apparent space dimensions, and not good enough by neither increasing nor decreasing the apparent space dimensions.

articleTitle: Analysis of energy consumption and powertrain parameters optimization of BEV based on running cycle
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Through the analysis of Running cycle of Changsha City, and according to the automobile running equation, the minimal energy of driving and braking under the sampling points of 0.1 second interval is analyzed and summed, the recycle of braking energy of motor is analyzed, two formulas for calculating the energy consumption of BEV are derived based on the running and braking cycle, the expression of energy consumption per unit distance is also derived. The optimization objective function for powertrain ratio are established with the energy consumption per unit distance and the dynamic factor under the Changsha loop running cycle and the main road running cycle. In order to assure the dynamic and economy performance of the designed car, the ratio boundary constraints is established with the effect of maximum speed and peak torque of the motor and the lower state of charge of the battery. And the powertrain ratio optimization is presented with a particle swarm optimization based on the simulated annealing, the weighting coefficient and the method of dealing with Constraints based on penalty function are introduced. And the results of optimization indicate that the dynamic factor is increased and the energy consumption per unit distance of the designed car is reduced under a group of weighting coefficient.

articleTitle: The optimization design of product form and its application based on BP-GA-CBR
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Most of the innovation designs of mechanical and electrical products are willing to take an improved design of the present products, which not only inherit the advantages of the current products, but also improve the efficiency and reliability of the design. Optimum method of evolutionary design scheme by feature lines and colour based on CBR is studied. This paper provides the division and quantification of product form element, the method and process of extracting form feature lines of case products. The double models of BP neural network of corresponding relation of feature lines, colour parameters and form perceptual image, and of form perceptual image, product function, product capability and performance and product sales is founded, which is further taken as fitness function of GA. The application process of this method is illustrated by an example of innovation design of family car form.

articleTitle: A new algorithm for movement precision reliability of the main motion of internal combustion engine
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Based on the geometrical theory of the reliability index and taking advantage of an improved particle swarm optimization with simple parameter setting and high convergence speed, a movement precision reliability computation method of the main motion of internal combustion engine is presented. The proposed method avoids the partial derivatives calculation in the performance function, and it is suitable for cases when partial derivatives are not available or are difficult to calculate. Simulations results on movement precision reliability of mechanism demonstrate that the proposed method is effective and practical, and provide a new effective approach for the calculation of movement precision reliability.

articleTitle: The quantitative usability evaluation of fighter cockpit digital interface
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Based on the working mechanism of human information processing system, the usability metrics system of fighter cockpit digital interface is deduced; and its method model of quantitative evaluation are further proposed. The cockpit digital interface prototypes of F18 and 4th-generation new fighter are made by the computer simulating. Selecting the performance measurement method, their usability is measured by experiment. The experimental analysis and discussion are also done.

articleTitle: Teaching and research about design methodology in animation design specialty
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Design methodology is an important foundation curriculum which inspires and trains design thought of students and grasping design method, in the teaching process we should pay attention to train student's specialized design thought and design idea, through the interactive teaching of scientific course content arrangement and various teaching ways, explore some teaching experience and the method that both adapts to the current teaching circumstances and be able to guide the student to study independently and creatively, in order to carry out the teaching work much better from now on, continually to improve the teaching level so as to obtain better teaching effect.

articleTitle: Products optimization based on green design—Restructuring and integration of package and packaged article
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Take the concept of green design as the starting point, regard the product as the integration of the package and packaged article so as to realize the optimization design of the product and, analyze and prove it with combination of specific design cases. It finally points out the enlightenment of the restructuring and integration of package and packaged article to the 3R optimization of product design.

articleTitle: Nano-precision positioning of GMA based on modified Preisach model
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Giant magnetostrictive actuators (GMA) are widely applied in ultra-precision positioning. However, the accuracy of GMA in positioning is intensively affected by hysteresis and nonlinearity of giant magnetostrictive materials. To characterize the hysteresis and nonlinearity, The nonlinear model of GMA based on modified Preisach model was established in this paper. Since the operation of Preisach model depends on the previous experimental data and the inversion algorithm of Preisach operators, which is always a complicated procedure, we proposed in this paper a point-standard iterated algorithm instead of the inversion of Preisach operators, in which the extremum values of Preisach model are stored in input memory matrix, and the input current can be determined by the comparison between target value and the current status of displacements. To conduct experiments with GMA under constant temperature, we designed a new actuator with double liquid-cooling structure. Experimental results showed that ultra-precision positioning in open loop with high accuracy and quick response can be realized based on the modified Preisach model and the point-standard iterated algorithm with our novel GMA structure.

articleTitle: Study on the 21st century SOHO office system design in China
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the development of the internet, our life style also take place a great change under the guide of the design. This article introduces the concept and characteristics of SOHO and its group, analyzes its produce, development and future trend, and occupation, put forward the viewpoint about the possibility of developing SOHO system in our country in the 21st century.

articleTitle: Seat surface design due to the analysis of body pressure test data
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Tested the body pressure distribution between human body and seat surface by using the measurement of body pressure, imported the data into three-dimensional software and changed it to be point form that can be edited. It analyzed the distribution of points and changed them into a surface, got a surface fits body buttock and used it to design a new inflexible chair. The seat surface of this chair can disperse the pressure of body buttocks to avoid excessive local pressure that cause discomfort to our body, meets people's comfortable needs on the inflexible seat.

articleTitle: Web-based Image Scale dynamic partition
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Image Scale, as a tool for product perceptual analysis, has been widely used in the actual design process. However, its object of study that is the psychological experience of people on products is a very vague and mutative notion, image scale is always considered to be instability and unreliability. Using web-based dynamic database can enhance amount of early collected data and summarize this data by the weighted method, stability and realiability of image scale can greatly improve, then helping designers obtain more accurate market information and users' needs conveniently.

articleTitle: A collaborative knowledge management system for product design based on folksonomy
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The aim of this research is to suggest folksonomy-based collaborative knowledge management system for designers in product development who collect, organize, analysis, presentation large quantity information. We performed field observation and studies to examination how designers in a group deal with information during the design process. We found that the traditional information organize methods have some problems like lack of collaboration and time consuming. Base on this research, we developed concept group work knowledge management application called FKP-PD. By implementing FKP-PD, we have showed the system reduces problems found from current process such as duplication of efforts and promiscuous information definition. In future study, we plan to evaluate the system further as well as adjust information input and output function which can be usefully applied to group design work.

articleTitle: Motorcycle helmet safety design research
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: By analyzing market research results of motorcycle helmets, this article proposes the improved motorcycle helmet safety design after discussing helmets' function, structure, materials, ergonomics, color, and many other characteristics. The design makes use of “honeycomb“ structure, solar panels and other methods to improve the safety performance of protective helmets, accomplishes motorcycle helmets safety innovation design.

articleTitle: Design on fast rescue stretcher with a single operation
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In order to improving shortage of manpower and ambulance's arrival in time , fast rescue stretcher with a single operation is manufactured and the structure of fast rescue stretcher are presented in great detail, one person only can finish the whole rescue process, which can save the manpower of the rescue site. The bicycle is quickly formed by deformation of the stretcher and enter quickly the site to rescue, the relevant patent is applied and novelty assessment report is done, The result show novelty of the stretcher.

articleTitle: User experience research of toy design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Interactive experience that children obtain in the process of playing toys is the basis for the toy design. But actually, we have done few researches on children interactive experience. It causes that the toy design doesn't match children's need. This paper takes the reasons why children like playing toys as the starting point. After doing some researches about children's psychological experience, I summarize a new method of the toy design.

articleTitle: Research on C2C e-commerce website usability evaluation system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the development of network technology and the acceleration of economic globalization, e-commerce has achieved vigorous development. In this paper, C2C e-commerce business website has been selected for the research on usability evaluation system. The “C2C e-commerce website usability evaluation system scale” is obtained based on an empirical study. It is concluded that content, technology, architecture, emotion, promotion, shopping operation and customization service are the seven leading indicators for evaluating and improving China's C2C e-commerce website usability.

articleTitle: Pulp concentration control by PID with BP neural network in the production of light weight cardboard
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: It is difficult for conventional optimal proportion integration differentiation (PID) controllers to obtain the optimal PID parameters to achieve the best operating position during papermaking process,because the parameters change greatly during papermaking process and the paper machine system is characterized with non-linear, time-varying and hysteresis qualities. Back propagation (BP) network can find the best PID parameters through online learning and adaptive processing. Combining BP network with PID controllers can make full use of both online learning ability of neural networks and the effectiveness of PID control. In this paper, neural network controller combining BP with PID is used for pulp concentration control in the production process of light weight cardboard. Using self-learning and adaptive functions of neural networks to make online real-time adjustment of PID parameters according to the actual working status online, the control system makes pulp concentration control in an optimal state, and ensures cardboard a uniform and stable basis weight.

articleTitle: Comparison of integrated and split design in structure design of paper package
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: According to the relation between external structure and internal structure, there are two design modes in structure design of paper package: split design, and integrated design. Through analyzing of examples of inkstone packages, we compared from the computation of compressive strength of empty boxes, computation of stacking capacity, and use of materials and molding process respectively. We concluded that integrated design in structure design of paper box has obvious advantage and development space, and it is a rational thinking in accordance with green package design and sustainable development.

articleTitle: Research on bionic design in product innovation
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With a deeper understanding of product innovation and sustainable development, the concept of “learn from nature” leads to a new round of exploration in bionic design. Based on the unique explanation of product innovation and the extended meaning of bionics, this issue has analysed a lot of innovative design patterns of which a good many design elements consist, and has imported new concepts of bionic design. Furthermore, according to different mode of product innovation, a new methodology on bionic design has been gotten, and the understanding of bionics has been expanded form the imitation of living creatures to the research of natural rules and the meaning of life. In consideration of design philology and the progress of society, this issue predicts the evolutional trend of imitated object for bionic design, and comes up with the idea that design has to be united to nature.

articleTitle: Personalized semantic search agent interaction mode research
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: While the semantic search technology has received considerable attention and the related technical study is in full swing, the research of the semantic search products' interaction mode on the client is still a blank. In order to achieve the concept to create a truly practical semantic product available to users, this paper discussed the client interaction mode and the interfaces design of the semantic search technology into products that from the end-user's perspective. Based on the applications, it proposed a personalized semantic search agent interaction model. By using advantages of semantic technology adding with user experience, it also achieved the optimal interaction solution that makes it more simple and smooth to complete info search, info organization, info browsing, info extraction and other complex search tasks.

articleTitle: Design of double-color injection mould with hot runner based on CAD/CAE technology
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In this paper, the structure and processing technology of double-color toothbrushes were analyzed. Filling process of plastic melt was simulated with the application of software Moldflow. Parameters of flow balance, injection pressure, fill time and cross-section sizes of secondary runners were obtained. Flow balance and filling effect were improved. Mould structure of double-color toothbrushes and key parts of mould were designed based on UG. Compared with traditional injection mould design methods, CAD/CAE technology shortens the cycle of mould design and development, reduces production cost and improves the quality of mould.

articleTitle: Research on lightweight design of vice-frame structure of fire-engine on basis of ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Having set up the finite element model based on some type and one pair of frames of fire engine of ANSYS, and has carried on the stress of imitating the actual operating mode and calculated and tested proving. Proceed from analysis results of finite element, has formed the mathematics model of optimization design, put forward the comparatively rational light design plan of quantization of pairs of frames through calculating.

articleTitle: Inspiration on modern furniture design in China from Nordic furniture design concept
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Through the designing features comparisons between Nordic furniture and Chinese modern furniture, this article points out the problems exist in China modern furniture design and at the same time drawn some inspiration and solutions through the development of Nordic furniture design

articleTitle: Modern Chinese furniture design system based on environmental values
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Based on the theory and cognition, we bring furniture into the system of human-furniture-society-nature(environment) so as to build modern Chinese furniture design system which promote human live in harmony with nature and ensure sustainable development, and then discuss the value appeals and reference function of environment in modern Chinese furniture design.

articleTitle: Embodied interaction — An analysis based on Chinese philosophy of body
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The human body plays a central role in shaping human interactions with physical world and virtual world. This paper asserts that body-based metaphor thinking is the main type of thinking through the analysis of Chinese philosophy of body. Contrast with the prevailing western viewpoints of embodiment, embodied cognition has some different annotations in view of the chinese philosophy of body. At last, We outline five aspects about embodied interaction to inspire the further research of interaction design, and reflect the role of human experience of temporality and spatiality in the interactive system.

articleTitle: Discussion on the symbolic features of animation characters' modeling language
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Experienced hundred years of developing history, animation today becomes not only an important form and narrative adopted by the mass media, but also a main force and significant impetus for the ecological formation and development of visual culture. Hence the ontological study on the animation art becomes increasingly vital and essential, while the modeling of the animation characters is a key component of the animation art ontology, and the most important visual element in motivated movies as well. This paper gives a systemized study on and interpretation of its modeling language, guided by the knowledge in the fields of semantics and pragmatics, combined with a large amount of cases of animation characters modeling, analyzes and systematically discusses the symbolic constituent of “painting” and “moving” in the animation characters modeling, and induces as well as sums up the various aspects of symbolic features.

articleTitle: A general study of design for disassembly for electronic products
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Waste electronic products and equipments are a severe environmental problem in China, because of the massive number of the waste produced everyday. The design for disassembly is an effective way to deal with this problem. This article discussed the principles and general process of disassembly and looked over some effective methods that can be applied in the design for disassembly.

articleTitle: The application of product bionic design in emotional design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Emotional product with an eye to people's demand and spiritual needs, make the person obtain inner cheerful aesthetic experience, let the life full of fun and moving. A good emotional design must consider from three different levels to meet the emotional needs of consumers. While, bionic product design through applications of different design methods meets the emotional needs of consumers to product in three different levels. Add affinity to products, bring abundant experience of feelings to consumers, deliver people's desire of emotional thinking.

articleTitle: Research on virtual exhibition platform based on user experience
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This study introduces user experience into the research and design of virtual exhibition platform, and through eye tracking experiment and user survey research, illustrates user experience's influence on research of virtual exhibition platform. Proposes research of virtual exhibition platform based on user experience, opens up a broader space for exhibition design, provides a rational point of view for designers to better grasp the exhibition design, and provides a reference for user design.

articleTitle: Research and design of the “Voice-Touch-Vision” Multimodal Integrated Voice Interaction in the Mobile Phone
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the continuous improvement of the functions of mobile phones, the human voice as the most natural way of communication has been drawn wide attention because of its convenience and accessibility. However, there exist some problems in the application of voice interactions. This paper analyses the current voice interaction, and induces three kinds of problems: accurate quantification, multiple choices, and accessory correction. In terms of the existing problems, this paper introduces a “Voice-Touch-Vision” Multimodal Integrated Voice Interaction (VTV-MIVI) concept. Based on VTV-MIVI, a linear & rotary touch model has been established to improve the accurate quantification of voice interaction. Finally, we applied the scheme in an immersive virtual driving game scene.

articleTitle: Forms and material of modern jewelry
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Nowadays, there are much plenty of modern jewelry that made of other materials except for those that made of traditional materials such as gold, silver, diamond, etc. The emergence of concept jewelry has made jewelry design more diversify, and any material can be made into vivid modern jewelry by artists with their appropriate craftsmanship. The decorative property, practical property and simple processing methods of modern jewelry inspire people who love jewelry design be involved in this industry. In daily life, a piece of appropriate beautiful jewelry manifest the personality of the person who wears the jewelry while raise him or her up. Due to these reasons, it is necessary to achieve a goal, that is, to put those charming and shining Chinese elements arose form Chinese folk arts into modern jewelry design while taking international elements into consideration, so as to create jewelry which satisfy the demands of market as well as meet individual needs and make the forms and materials of jewelry much diversified.

articleTitle: Interface design in the ship navigation information system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: People with different backgrounds have different cognitive processing, which can affect how they use computers. With the computer technology developing and user specializing, different information processing of specific user of interface design has become significant issues, especially in the information processing system. Studying on information processing differences of specific user from various perspectives, including information accumulation, decisionmaking, etc, can provide useful information which can guide and modify interface design. In this paper, we made a simulation design of the ship navigation information system(used in medium size ship) to show how the information processing of specific user affect the design and creatively developed design conceptions the "reduced information processing strategy" to address effects effectively. Finally, we offered a brief conclusion, and throw light onto future work.

articleTitle: Estimation of distribution algorithm based on nested Archimedean copulas constructed with Lévy subordinators
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This paper proposes an improved estimation of distribution algorithm(EDA) based on a class of nested Archimedean copulas which is constructed with Lévy subordinators(LNAcopula-EDA). Utilizing of Lévy subordinators, a class of nested Archimedean copulas has been conveniently constructed. In order to exploit EDA to solve high-dimensional continuous optimization problem, we fully use of the capability of nested Archimedean copula in modeling high-dimensional joint distribution of multivariate with complex rank correlation structure to construct the probability distribution model of promising individuals in EDA. Then, the procedure of LNAcopula-EDA has been presented. And comparing with other EDAs that based on copula functions for the benchmark functions in the experiments, the obtained results demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on generation algorithm of virtual fitting room based on R-S mode
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: According to the R-S mode, to solve terminal consumers easily fitting online in the B2C, C2C pattern e-business environment, it is necessary to provide a realtime interactive platform making fitting process visual. The system gets the data of custom body sizes to construct virtual fitting model through photos the custom uploaded. And then the model tries on different costumes and the system shows the fitting effect. In the process of selecting the optimum fitting effect, the generation algorithm based on GRA is adopted to decrease operation amount and help the consumers select their best clothes.

articleTitle: Research on the control of three-dimension based on the Mobile Internet Device
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: All kinds of computing terminals connect human beings and computers, even with everything by omnipresent communication network in the era of pervasive computing. The technology of human-computer interaction determines the possibility and agreeableness in practical application of the connection between human and everything. Mobile Internet Devices (MID) are in direct contact with end users, such as cell phone, tablet PC, Web TV, and etc. Mature human-computer interaction techniques influence whether users are satisfied with the products and the content they provide, which decides the survival or perish of the products in the market.

articleTitle: A novel flexible workflow system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The information system used in enterprise before didn't differentiate the management logic and application logic strictly, which makes the system unable to meet the increasingly open and changing dynamic environment, and gives a serious impediment to the development of the enterprise itself. According to the reality, with the combination of SOA ideology and workflow hierarchical description model, this paper is mainly about how to build a resilient and flexible workflow management system under C/S framework, and to fill the need of new and modifying operation process for enterprise by increasing the flexibility and scalability of system. At last, there shows a workflow management model proposed in this paper, which realize the separation of management and operation, reduce the complexity of system designing.

articleTitle: Human-oriented design of color elements in the interior design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: As color is the liveliest and most vibrant element, it plays an important role in interior design. Proper and scientific application of colors can not only create high aesthetic value and human-oriented style, but also demonstrate the occupants' personal expression. From the point in interior design, this essay analyses the human-oriented design of color elements through the constitution of color elements, human-oriented matching of color elements and globality.

articleTitle: Research on computer simulation designing for building Daylight and Sunshading system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Through theory analysis and computer simulation, this paper utilizes Ecotect as study tools, take some building scheme design process as an example, and combine the climate characteristic on the Summer Solstice of Beijing, China. By analyzing the form of the windows, System of Sunshading and Daylight to launch the conceptual design of the building, using quantitative analysis to compare the design proposal, in this way this paper may offer scientific basis for the building energy-conservation designing.

articleTitle: Emotional design in the interface of website for the aged
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Based on the analysis and research on the aged groups, with deep understanding on the characteristics and needs of the aged physically and psychologically, connected with the features of a website interface design, inspired by the three levels (visceral, behavioral, reflective)of emotional design, this thesis develops some methods of website interface design which reflects the humanistic care for the elderly, and tries to make contribution to lessen the spiritual emptiness on network and meet emotional needs of the old of the contemporary era.

articleTitle: SketchUp aided dynamic landscape design—A case of Helv Fuan shopping street landscape design of Hudai
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Along with the rapid development of computer technology, computer-aided design software is widely applied to various industries. And there is no exception for landscape design. This essay is about the relationship between computer-aided design and dynamic landscape design, and discusses the characteristics, methods and steps of using computer-aided design theory for dynamic landscape design. Through a detailed explanation of a real case, we introduced the important role computer-aided dynamic landscape design has played in the idea-developing process. We also come up with the corresponding solutions and suggestions, and carry out a fundamental discussion on its application outlook.

articleTitle: A new approach to realize sustainability —Integrated design under the product and service system framework
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Product service system (PSS) is to integrate tangible products and intangible service to build “sustainable solutions”, in order to meet some specific needs from customers, which is a new idea and new pathway to realize sustainability. This paper analyzes the background, motivation and core concepts of PSS arisen, and the pathway driving to sustainability through PSS case study.

articleTitle: The decision-making design study on sewing machine design improvement based on the QFD
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The speed of the new product development in sewing machine industry is slow. Due to the influence of the general situation of sewing industry, time and funds, combined with the uncertainty of the development result, the enterprises find hard to make decision on how and when to develop their new products or improve old ones, though they have eager and strong desire. To meet the very demands, the article introduces the QFD, sets up the house of quality, and ensures the best group of the improvement measures and contribution under the restriction of the cost.

articleTitle: Future developing strategies of enterprise based on the study of the evolution of consumer demand
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Nowadays, only to meet escalating demand of consumers, the enterprises will endow unbeaten competitiveness. The paper, based on CS theory of the three levels of the product composition, summarizes the evolution of consumer demand into three stages: the core product consumption stage, tangible product consumption stage and additional product consumption stage. Thus it points out that, at this time, consumer demand shows emotional, personalized and experiencing characteristics. According to above consumer demand features, future developing strategies of enterprise are presented, such as ask consumers to participate in product research and development, continuously get feedbacks from consumers, improve the customer satisfaction, focus on the technology innovation, focus on the design innovation, which can grasp the trend of world's cultural and creative industry development accurately.

articleTitle: A study on “5W1H” user analysis on interaction design of interface
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The availability of digital products is intended to satisfy people's requirements of using digital communication technology to change life style. And users, products and the using environment is a closely related whole system. Designer's task is to cope with every element so that each element of interface can do good service to product design. To judge a good and user-oriented interface design, the following can be used as reference: the effectiveness, efficiency and satisfaction of the interface to users in the process of using. In other words, that is whether the interface product is easy to learn or not, whether it attracts users or not and user's feeling in using the product. The purpose of this thesis intend to discuss how to use 5W1H to achieve user analysis in interaction design of interface, so as to develop interface that users want. Meanwhile, to help designers be clear of users' idea can be reflected on the final interface demand and satisfy users' requirement, finally, to improve user's satisfaction.

articleTitle: Motion presence study on automobile driving simulator
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The automobile driving simulator is developed, the structure and work principle are presented briefly. The visual system, which is large-scale and has the advantage of high-quality, is developed. The 6-DOF (degree-of-freedom) motion platform is introduced to provide the realistic motion presence during the time of automobile's driving along the sloping and bumpy roads as well as speed-up, speed-down, turn-aside and sideslip. The experimental result show the automobile driving simulator can be fit with the need of driving training with satisfying reality and immersion.

articleTitle: Information graphics as a visual language
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Information graphics (inforgraphics) plays a great role in information visualization. It is a valuable way to explore the visualization style of complex data or information based on a universal visual language. Through the analysis of the attributes of fundamental graphics and the information communication, several composed inforgraphics design principles are put forward and estimated in the application of information visualization of nature disaster.

articleTitle: Structure coding method for part engineering drawing
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: A kind of structure code based on part engineering drawing structure models is proposed. The geometric graph of part engineering drawing is labeled as functional surface. The functional surface which is attached topologically is determined according to the fact that whether they are in the common edge, or whether they have concurrent or point in the edge, and then the position relationship and distribution relationship between functional surface is also decided. Finally 2D structure model of part is generated. By referring to the linear symbolic notation for compounds in chemical database, a structure coding method is presented. The similar structure engineering drawing is retrieved by structure coding.

articleTitle: Basic Course education in China a survey and comparative analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to report the results of a survey and comparative analysis on the Basic Course education in China. Based on C.G. Boucharenc's international survey, this paper offered a systemic survey and analysis following aspects of “General organization of the Basic Course”, “Objectives of the Basic Course”, and “Pedagogical approach and the essential themes of the Basic Course”, and made the contrastive analysis with Boucharenc's data. It puts forward that China's Basic Course education focuses on two-and three-dimensional teaching exercises, and both teaching means and applications of new theory are not good enough. These results are useful for determining the status of Basic Course education in China.

articleTitle: The combination of two consecutive strokes in automotive styling from 2-D to 3-D
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This paper presents two novel algorithms, the distance comparison algorithm and the stroke analysis algorithm, which try to combine two consecutive raster-based 2-D strokes into one vector-based 2-D curve which can be used then to form a 3-D surface. The data is obtained from digital sketching. Each stroke contains several sequential 2-D points which can be used as the control points or nodes in the stroke. However, the data in the different strokes belongs to the different data spaces. The combination of two strokes is to connect the data from the different data spaces into one data space with a new sequence of all the original points. The methods give a feasible way to join many strokes during sketching in the conceptual design stage of automotive styling.

articleTitle: Basic Design for cultivating creative thinking
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to explore the teaching methods for Basic Design which aims at cultivating creative thinking for the design beginners. Based on Bounded Rationality, for the essence of creative thinking like “selection”, “breakthrough”, and “reconstruction”, this paper proposed some new teaching methods, which included “simple problem”, “limitation”, and “quantity”. Moreover this paper discussed the relationships between rationality and creative thinking, and the applied range of above methods. These new methods are useful for improving the teaching quality of Basic Design and cultivating creative thinking for the design beginners.

articleTitle: Vicissitudes of traditional settlement landscape of Wuzhen in modern commercial development
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Protection and development of traditional Chinese settlement landscape is a topic attracting much attention in progress of modern urbanization. The reconstruction and development mode of Wuzhen represents a development direction of traditional settlement landscape in modern society. The most important feature of Wuzhen mode is that it retains the characteristics of traditional landscape and converts them into sources for modern commercial development. This paper describes the characteristics of traditional settlement landscape of Wuzhen in the following aspects: overall layout, primitive living space, riverside view etc. It also observes heritage and transformation of such characteristics in modern commercial development process. It is hoped to obtain some hints from analysis of this mode which may be conductive to transformation of traditional settlement landscapes of our country.

Author Keywords: Water Town in Southern Yangtze River Reach

articleTitle: Research into 3D pixel animation techniques
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
