abstract: The thesis discusses the production techniques of 3D pixel animation based on 3D curved surface shapes, determining the position of 3D pixel animation by dividing the bounding boxes and the intersection of curved surface, which discrete the shape into 3D patches to increase the efficiency of determining intersection through calculating the area. Based on the prototype system developed by Rhinoceros, we achieve the rapid production of 3D pixel animation.

articleTitle: Innovation team construction research based on animation creation experiment demonstration center
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The animation creation experiment demonstration center is the important place to train animation talent, must fully use and display the function and potency of creation experiment demonstration center. The animation innovation team construction needs to be based on the specialty characteristic and the present teaching environment, fully use the platform of experiment demonstration center to carry out the innovation practice, train students' innovation ability and team spirit under the existing condition, so as to promote the progress of education reform and talent training pattern. The innovation team construction involves many factors and broad scope, this article mainly starts research from the establishment of innovation team, the management of innovation team and how to carry out team innovation practice activity, so as to obtain some related revelation and summary.

articleTitle: Music emotional design by evolutionary algorithms
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Music emotional design has been studied for many years, and there has been a growing interest in analyzing and design emotion in music by the evolutionary algorithms. Therefore, it's necessary to organize and categorize representative literature. The study presents an exhaustive survey of studies on one or more aspects of music emotional design by the evolutionary algorithms. In doing so, a classification of the literature based on the goal of what the studies want to achieve is developed. Such a classification not only highlights the significant results and unifies existing work, but also provides a foundation for future research in Music Emotional Design by the evolutionary algorithms.

articleTitle: On the procedure and methods in modern furniture Green design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With times of ecological civilization coming, Green design is the new horizon of modern furniture innovation and development. Based on the theories of green design, the paper explored the strategies, methods and procedures of green design for modern furniture and described the framework of implementation. Finally, studying expectation of green design for modern furniture was given.

articleTitle: Prediction of CNC Heavy-duty Horizontal Lathe position precision and its application based on evaluation of uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: According to type B evaluation of uncertainty, A method is presented to predict position precision of CNC Heavy-duty Horizontal Lathe. A case studying on X axle feeding system, mathematical model of position precision which is based on standard uncertainty is established. Calculation results are compared with experiment truth-value, model's feasibility is proved. It provides a theoretical basis for further enhance the position precision of heavy-duty CNC lathe.

articleTitle: Evaluation method of processing technology information for mechanical products based on information axiom
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: According to the theory for measuring the information of mechanical products and with the combination of the classification of the information of mechanical products, the processing technology information of mechanical products was studied deeply, and the measurement method of processing technology information for mechanical products was presented. This method can evaluate the advantages and disadvantages of the process file in the initial stage of the product design, which can reduces the manufacturing costs of products effectively. The superiority of this method was verified through the analysis of a concrete example.

articleTitle: New perspective on product design in the period of low carbon economy
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In the present paper, the author presents more reasonable and more comprehensive location on product design by analyzing the characteristics of low carbon economy time, she puts forward Four-dimensional product design standards consisting of practical, aesthetic, emotional and ecological standards which accord with the economic development model and she also proposes “from Pregnancy to the afterlife” ecological view of product design and the Trouble Design method to assure the ecological dimension of product design. The aim of this article anticipates that the designer can conduct the consumers to consume reasonably through his/her products and to arouse the consumers' environmental consciousness in order to realize green and peace all over the world and make human beings'life more nice.

articleTitle: Visual sense and the visual features of design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Visual sense is the most important sense for people, and people would use the visual sense most to get the information of the outside world, they would also use it the most to exchange the information in the man-machine system. The efficiency of the man-machine system and the stability of design would rely on the visual sense a lot. The key point of design and its function is how to make the exterior features of design fit the visual sense. Therefore, it's very important and necessary to study the visual sense and exterior features of design to enhance the efficiency of man-machine system, and help the design to express itself by means of the exterior features, and help people to see and understand the design well and quickly. This paper analyses the visual sense and discusses many visual features of design, the study on the clear expression and conciseness of visual information would help designers to get some more ideas of how to design the exterior features.

articleTitle: Research of biomorphic imitation on the design of children's toys
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Biomorphic imitation of children's toys design was researched deeply in this paper. Combined with rules of children's cognition and behavior characteristics, and based on the special function of biomorphic imitation, five kinds of effective and innovative design methods were obtained for children's toys. Through analyzing many classical biomorphic imitation cases of children' toys design from multi-angle, it is proved that the methods were feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Applications and researches on Web3D virtual reality-based technology in architectural design expressions
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Along with the approach of experiencing economic times and continuous development of digital technology, we are requested to incorporate virtual reality-based technology into architectural design. The incorporation of virtual reality-based technology into architectural design will greatly improve its main sections and efficiency. This paper, in view of architectural design expression, analyzes limitations and deficiencies which have been found in the current architectural design expressions, and makes advantages of Web3D virtual reality-based technology to definite novel architectural drawings marked by interactive design expressions. Furthermore, the paper has analyzed its main characteristics featured in interaction, fluency, feeling of reality and real-time comparison. The paper also discusses the manner for generating virtual architecture models and illuminates the main meanings combining practical situations in architectural design.

articleTitle: Application of ergonomics in the living bathroom environment
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This paper analyses our indoor health problems through research, data collection, analysis of the current space. And the comprehensive application of ergonomics, modern methodology and the indoor environment of the bathroom layout design theory, the structure of barrier-free design. This thesis aims to provide people with a reasonable, comfortable, beautiful environment health space.

articleTitle: Application study of ergonomics on college apartments' unit furniture
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: At present, university students are a major concern in our society. Student apartment is the main place for both living and resting. The design of apartments' unit furniture not only have great influence on life quality of students, but also have important meaning towards students' body and mind health. This paper takes Nanchang University as an example, analyzes the present situation of student apartment's unit furniture, and find out design flaws of unit furniture. Methods: the data of height are obtained by taking 240 students in Nanchang University at random. Using statistical software-SPSS, we can carry out statistical analysis on the data of height and get the statistical data of the students' height. According to design flaws of present unit furniture, we provide some suggestion based on human factors engineering. The object is designing apartments' unit furniture of humanity for students' living and resting and providing comfortable studying environment for students.

articleTitle: The multi-stroke combination in the automotive styling from 2-D to 3-D
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This paper presents a novel multi-stroke combination algorithm. It tries to set up a bridge between 2-D sketching and 3-D modeling that is the most important stage in automotive styling. The algorithm gives a way to connect raster-based multi-stroke with a vector-based curve which is the optimal expression of the multi-stroke. Two parts are discussed here: the sequential section combination algorithm and the successive stroke combination algorithm. By comparing the different ways, the final algorithm gives a better result which is more suitable to the way a stylist sketches.

articleTitle: Research on human-computer interactive interface in visualized information
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Since the computer and internet were introduced, the time and spatial barriers have been broken by message conveying, and the amount and the speed of information has been increased than before. The aim of information visualization is to convey complex information to the audience more effectively,and visual perception-based interface is considered as the most effective medium for information dissemination. In this essay, through discussion and further understanding of application of human-computer interactive in visualized information design, we clarify the human-oriented theory of interface design and apply it in the whole process of interface design.

articleTitle: Intelligent aided multicolor design technology based on semantics
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Aim at the establishment of a complete intelligent aided product color design system, raises the idea of multicolor connection semantics, upbuilds a fuzzy semantics set that shows multicolor harmony degree, discuss the way of using color space length to identify color connection semantics, put forwards the intelligent aided product multicolor design method based on semantics.

articleTitle: The design of the tourist souvenirs related to Universe Globe of China based on the concept of harmony
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Through analysis of the core texts of Chinese culture, including Yi Ching, Lao Tse and Confucius, this paper concludes that the foundation of Chinese culture is as follows: based on Yi, the harmony of Tao and human spirit constitute s the root of the great Chinese culture. Under the guidance of “Fu”, which suggests harmony, Universe Globe of China is designed, and its concept is elaborated. The design of tourist souvenirs is thus a promotion of Chinese culture as well as a contributor to the construction of socialist harmony.

articleTitle: Characteristics of animation industry in United Kingdom and the inspirations for Chinese animation industry
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Animation industry has become a new growth point of national economy. The development of global creative industries also indicates that a new century of culture and art-focused, creative animation industry is coming. As the leader in the world creative industries, the UK's animation industry has also taken the forefront in the world. In this paper, we made a comprehensive description of the characteristics of the British animation industry through the following three aspects: creativity, education and government policies, analyzed the root causes of its success; and combining with the status quo of Chinese animation industry, we summarized some inspiration from the aforementioned three aspects, trying to explore some new ideas for the development of Chinese animation Industry.

articleTitle: Neck entertainment fitness system based on face recognition
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: How to integrate exercises and entertainments by applying computer technology to make exercises more entertaining, or to make entertainments more fascinating, has become a popular topic in the world. It aims to realize the human-computer interaction by using the technical features of integrating games and exercises. Face-recognition as a key technique in face information processing starts to draw common interests in the areas of pattern recognition and computer vision. It is an important approach for human-computer multimodal interaction. This paper presents a neck entertainment fitness system, which uses computer technologies such as video technology, face recognition technology to provide a convenient, simple and free body-building system. By using the common computer hardware, whether in the office, lab, or at home, hotels and other indoor places, people can enjoy the fun easily.

articleTitle: Analysis of the design trend of rural household refrigerators
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the increasing improvement of the rural life, household refrigerators has been playing an important role in the rural area. At present, the design of the household refrigerators is currently tending to maturity. But in the long run, accompanied by the deficiency of the existing material image and functional elements, the household refrigerator design also has a long way to go. Therefore, the authors analyzed the design trend of the rural household refrigerators from the development perspective.

articleTitle: Image retrieval based on color, texture, shape and SVM relevance feedback
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: After the research of the principle of SVM, it is applied to the relevance feedback of the content-based image retrieval. First do a initial retrieval separately by MEPG-7 Dominating Color, Gray-level Co-occurrence Matrix and histogram, then do a feedback using the SVM for the new round retrieval. In the experiment we comparing the SVM feedback result with the result of weight adjusting-based algorithm, prove that SVM feedback can greatly improve the recall level, get more items that be of interest to the user.

articleTitle: Research of appropriate design theory in product design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Based on the ideology of being together in harmony between human and nature, appropriate design plays a more and more important role in product design. The core content of it includes healthy design, simplicity design, regional design, middlebrow design, proper design and selective design, which interact and inter-influence with each other to make the product design in China develop correctly and healthily.

articleTitle: Research on theories and methodologies of integrated product development
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Integrated product development is a model of new product development system, and also it is a product life cycle optimization method. Based on the research of integrated product development literatures, from the emergence of integrated product development, from the theoretical study, the framework and the analysis of development process, this paper sets up new views and puts forward some suggestions on the aspects that integrated product development needs to improve.

articleTitle: Design and teaching research of dynamic interaction VI
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Brand visual identity (VI) is a relatively mature field. It has a set of basic teaching contents. With the development of multimedia, dynamic interactive interface become increasingly an important window to display brand image, but the system theory of VI in the design of multimedia interactive interface has not been formed. At the meantime the VI course is focused on the design content of traditional print media and the multimedia is ignored, which also revealed the existing blind spot in VI design. So this paper puts forward the novel concept of dynamic interaction of VI based on the relationship among UI, the existing VI and the dynamic interactive VI, expands the teaching content of VI from the existing static and one-way transfer of information to the dynamic and two-way interactive transfer design of visual identity.

articleTitle: The innovation and explorations in “the design for catering”
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Catering, which is an indispensable part in people's life, is also the basic reflection of the people's life quality. Through giving a new defined value to the purpose of catering and researching of how to express the design language and methods, this article gives an initial analysis of how to improve the design quality. It has an important value and significance to meet the demands of people who love and enjoy life.

articleTitle: A study of the localized Chinese animation development strategies: The thinking from the animation brand of “Pleasant Goat”
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: “Pleasant Goat and Big Big Wolf”➀ becomes the most influential animation brand in China over last 20 years. However, the success cannot conceal the obstacle and the issues among the Chinese animation development. The author will analize the obstacle and the issues, and bring forward the strategies which are suitable for the Chinese localized animation development.

articleTitle: Correlation model of overall and local sitting comfort based on rating scales
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: To evaluate the perception of subjective sitting comfort requires overall comfort and local comfort as main indexes .The reliability and validity of a rating scale which was designed to measure local and overall comfort of two separate sitting postures on an adjustable chair was examined. The subjects included 20 males and 20 females, ranging in age from 22 to 32 (Mean=27, SD=4.7). Overall comfort was evaluated by direct or indirect method. The indirect overall comfort measure cannot substitute for direct measure from experimental data. As a result, the linear regression models were constructed between direct overall and local sitting comfort. The overall comfort can be predicted by three local comfort indexes.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A study on the curriculum design of character animation program in California Institute of the Arts
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: A review of the study on information design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The paper discusses the issues of information decentralization and communication disorder faced with the information society, points out the necessity and significance of Information Design, focuses on the analysis of conditions of Chinese and foreign scholars' study on Information Design, and makes a study review on it and indicates that in the process of industrial restructuring and transforming the mode of economic development, only by developing the industry of Information Design, can information resources be effectively integrated, communicated and used, and thus reaching the goal of sustainable development for economy and society.

articleTitle: Creative design of multi - functional office chair based on TRIZ theory
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Little change has been made in present office chairs over the past decades. The study on office chairs is confined to their appearance molding and comfort without much innovation in the function of office chairs, especially functional diversity. Based on TRIZ, a creative design of multi-functional office chair has been accomplished. Its functional principle and structure are analyzed. A type of can realize the normal, comfortable office, and the rest of the multi-functional office chair is exploited.

articleTitle: Research of product innovative models based on QFD, TRIZ and DOE
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Through the analysis and comparison of the characteristics of QFD, TRIZ and DOE, it builds the QTD product innovation models at the base of the techniques of the quality function development, the theory of inventive problem solving and the DOE experimental design, providing a new method for innovative product design.

articleTitle: Analysis on the development and combination of intelligence toys and animation industry
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Toy is indispensable for everyone in life. It's a carrier of culture and also a collateral product which can not be ignored. Since ancient time, intelligence toy is a kind of toy which is the source of innovation and entertainment for people. This thesis hopes to study the value of toys, especially the value of intelligence toys, for the purpose of arousing more attention to the toy design and development at the same time. The intelligence toy design has practical significance, not only conducive to the development of toys design, but also provide a theoretical basis for the nationalization and modernization of toys, as well as educational research, social science research and the development of national art.

articleTitle: Algorithm Based Graphic in art design and education
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Recently, Algorithm Based Graphic (ABG) prevails in the world of art design for its unique visual effect. This paper demonstrates the definition, characters and history of ABG. And we instruct the method and tool for ABG. We point out the importance of ABG for art design education and the necessity of establishing such course for students of art design.

articleTitle: Teaching reform and practice in curriculum of engineering science of industrial design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In economy transformation period of China, realization the transformation from "Made in China" into "Created in China" is extremely urgent. Enterprises, especially middle and small ones, need more industrial designers. They also put forward new demands on designer' knowledge structure. Designer must be able to solve not only product form design problems but also problems in production manufacturing. So, in the present industrial design education, it is important to improve students' ability to solve production manufacturing problems. For this purpose, we provide a new lesson named engineering science of industrial design. Teaching example is presented to show the effect of the course.

articleTitle: Study of structure - properties relationship of aramid paper: Application of image processing technology
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In order to study the effects of the dosage of dispersant and papermaking methods on the formation and mechanical strength of aramid paper, fiber mass distribution of aramid paper using different amount of dispersant and different papermaking ways were analysed by image processing technology, and its effect on the mechanical strength of aramid paper was also investigated. The results showed that adding polyethylene oxide (PEO) into the pulp suspension could obviously improve the formation of aramid paper, and the best formation of aramid paper could be obtained when the dosage of PEO was 0.15%, which corresponding to the maximum mechanical strength of aramid paper, further increase of the amount of PEO resulted in a decrease of the formation and mechanical strength of aramid paper. When the same pulp was used to manufacture aramid paper with the same grammage, the formation and mechanical strength of aramid paper manufactured by laminating was superior to the aramid paper manufactured by single ply forming, and the formation and mechanical strength of the wire side-top side laminated paper were better than that of the wire side-wire side laminated paper.

articleTitle: A product visualization model construction method in Computer Aided Conceptual Design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This paper analyzes the visualization integrated environment design elements in the process of Computer Aided Conceptual Design (CACD), discussing the general design cogitation (thinking) process of product conceptual design .At the same time, we built a model for aiding visualization. Finally, an example application of the developed software prototype proves the model is useful and feasible.

articleTitle: User's behavior -based creative product design process
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to present a creative product design process (PDP) based on user's behavior (UB) to product. Based on the interactive relationships between user and product, combining with three levels of useful, usable, and desirable using activity, our work explored the user's behavioral characters, and then outlined the creative product design process based on these characters. Based on this new PDP, a series of designed creative cups were analyzed for exploring the highly inter-related relations between design creativity and user's behavior. The results suggest that user's behavior situates in different scenarios (always including six sorts) and involves a series of actions which operate the different parts of product according to time sequence. And the new PDP involves four phases of scenario building, behavioral process analyzing, unexpected needs discovering and structure realizing. These PDP are very useful for enhancing designers' creative performances as well as enhancing users' dynamic behavioral needs.

articleTitle: Architecture design strategies coping with the concept of low carbon
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: As one of the biggest energy consumption activities, construction has great influence on the environment during its forming & existence process. In response to today's environmental crisis, the whole world is promoting low-carbon economy. During the whole life cycle of the construction, our architects can update design concept and adjust design way to promote the living environment. This paper tries to explore architecture design under the concept of low-carbon economy.

articleTitle: Research on the construction method of urban cultural characteristic design DNA supporting regional recognition
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The regional recognition based on urban culture is essentially about the design of city image as well as in a rapidly changing and keenly competitive environment. In order to solve the culture characteristic recognition and inheriting problem of a city, the work presented in this paper focuses on proposing an analysis and construction method of cultural characteristic element design DNA, which could be employed to mold the urban image. Then the construct system of characteristic design DNA of city in visual identity was present and the key technologies and the forming course of regional characteristic cultural elements were analyzed. Finally, Kensei engineering methods is used to achieve the visual sense of quantity. Through experiments and statistical analysis of results, the regional characteristic cultural elements image database is created.

articleTitle: Research on universal design of interior layout of the bus
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In the view of comparing the bus situation at home and abroad, based on theories of knowledge ergonomics, body size, physiological anatomy, design psychology, modern design aesthetics and color science, through comparative analysis of design programs, combined with the market evaluation we fix the universal design program of interior layout of the bus in 10 design programs., It is not only with a variety of barrier-free facilities for the vulnerable groups, but also with the reasonable interior layout which can meet the greatest people needs of the convenience and security.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The innovative application of Guangxi ethnic symbols in the Zhuang folk songs cultural tourism package
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Public landscape design in post-disaster reconstruction area after Wenchuan Earthquake
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Sichuan province has various folks and Travel Resources before the Earthquake. However the Economic, cultural and environment of the areas influenced by Wenchuan Earthquake were deeply changed. It is urgent to reconstruct public landscape to satisfy not only people located in disaster area, but also tourists from other provinces and countries. This paper firstly summarized the main principles and public landscape design elements of post-disaster reconstruction. Then a public landscape design case combined the characteristic of disasters' geology with Qiang's minority culture on Wenchuan was discussed in detail. It showed the design harmony the cultural and social needs in reconstruction area.

articleTitle: Based on divide and conquer system reliability modeling
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Base on the study of traditional systems reliability modeling. This paper presents a new method of system reliability modeling based on divide and conquer, and use this method to model the system reliability model in a ship system. This method has a certain reference value for carrying out large-scale complex system reliability modeling work.

articleTitle: A research into application of rebuilding design of container
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This paper begins with the situation of container building development, analyzes the form and methods of container's rebuilding design, rebuilding design of containers and recycling of social material resources are combined to each other, this paper also puts forward the critical influence of application of rebuilding design of container on transportation technology.

articleTitle: Technology investigation on developing fit garment patterns with different size in 2D and 3D CAD system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In order to customize different size garment patterns, several methods in computer aided design system can be adopted. Traditional grading technology in 2D CAD and new parametrical body modeling technology in 3D CAD were introduced in the paper. The main grading methods include point grading, rule table grading, cut-line grading and parametric grading. The principles and characteristics of these methods were outlined combined with a typical 2D system (Richpeace) in the Chinese market. In 3D system, mannequin or garment parametrical modeling is most important precondition for developing individual garment patterns. Several novel researches about parameterization approach are reviewed. Finally, a pattern customizing case on a fit pants with four different size was implemented based on 3D modeling technology.

articleTitle: Green design in the education on industrial design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Green design is the inevitable way for continuous development. The sense of green design is the basic capability which the stylist should be hold. The knowledge of green design should be emphasized in the educational process of industrial design in order to enhance the faculty of the students.

articleTitle: Structure reconstruction and optimization of the BF-type flexible drive
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The performance of the BF type flexible drive in use is worse, The existence of a larger pressure of round and uneven, and even have a negative pressure, so easy to lapse institutions. Increase the transmission through the gravity balancer equipment, designed to transform the structure of the gravity balancer to optimize the performance of design parameters so that performance can be greatly improved, it provide a way to improve and optimize the existing equipment, and it would have good development prospects and market value.

articleTitle: Intelligent three-dimensional health heating system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In order to change the sanitary environment facilities, meet the people's quality of life requirements. This product is integration of warm wind, thermal cycle heating and infrared heating of three-dimensional mode of heating design,the multi-level shower area even raise the temperature become ture. Bathing areas to achieve the concentration of air particles in state care and life real-time network alarm,ensure a safe and comfortable bathing environment. Establish water quality based on air conditions and adaptive model of human skin, can be measured using infrared sensors and electrodes to conduct semi-permeable membrane for hydrogen ion skin pH data collected, developed based on the human body clock rhythm of smart three photovoltaic lighting system,and to realize through circadian rhythm parameter adjustment color illumination, can be adapted to the human body the need of work day and night melatonin levels and living conditions. Help the vulnerable groups of family situation in the custody of different places,and to ensure the flow of information to help people to integrate the biological clock of time effectively, strengthen the security of home life, comfort.

articleTitle: Car body Hybrid design technology in forward and reverse way
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The advantages and disadvantages of car body design with the forward and the reverse way is discussed. Hybrid design process with forward and reverse way for car body is proposed. Hybrid design interface technology of car body is study. The three different types of data interface are given. Combined with the hybrid design examples, the new design manner is realized.

articleTitle: The main characteristics of web art
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The main characteristics of web art include distance interaction, the containerization of media art expression, the publicity of media art communication, tactile experience of media art engagement and the virtual reality of media sociology.

articleTitle: Research of the product design and development process based on system theory
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The relationship between system theory and the product design, the process of product development has been described. It compared the merits and demerits of serial and parallel product development processes and, with the guidelines of system theory, put forward and analyzed the planning actions and corresponding necessity existed in the indistinct initial phase in product development process. It also analyzed the optimizing effect of planning actions in product design & development process. Thus, it obtained the model of product design & development process based on system theory so as to clarify the indistinct initial phase, shorten product development time and, improve the effectiveness of enterprise's product development.

articleTitle: Research on robustness of conceptual design based on axiomatic design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Scheme of product conceptual design has crucial effect on the quality of product. To improve the quality of product, it is very necessary to research on the robustness of the scheme. By analyzing the theory of axiomatic design, theorems of functional robustness and compensation are proposed based on axiomatic design, in order to enhance the robustness of the scheme, and the conceptual design of block forming machine is taken as an example to show the application. Results indicate that the improvement of robustness in conceptual design can lay a solid foundation for next stage design and product quality.

articleTitle: On the visual image similarities and differences between Chinese and foreign vehicle logos
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Based on a sample survey and comparative analysis on visual image of Chinese and foreign vehicle logos, the paper discusses their similarities and differences in the composition of name, graphic feature, overall geometric forms and application of colors. It provides corresponding reference data for the visual image design of automobile logos.

articleTitle: Research on artistic charm of the young girl images in Japanese anime
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: According to traditional culture Japanese anime has created a large number of classic young girls, who not only have the excellent image design and contains a wealth of ideas. That Japanese anime praises feminist consciousness, focuses form design and forms model style system impacts deeply contemporary animation. Colourful female roles lack systematic research. This passage attempts to analyse the image of young girls from female consciousness, form style and culture factors in order to research their artistic charm.

articleTitle: Study on ergonomics evaluation method of the cockpit display system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This paper studies for the information display system of aircraft cockpit human-machine interface. Based on the fuzzy pattern recognition theory, the present study puts forward a new method for subjective evaluation of aircraft cockpit display system design. By building a standard evaluation model database, and improving on the approach degree as the needs of the model identify, the information display system is evaluated on the principle of choosing the nearest. Verified by case, fuzzy pattern recognition model by this method is feasible. It can also be applied to other fields of human-machine interface display system ergonomics evaluation, and has good popularity as well as engineering applications.

articleTitle: Influence of aesthetics in animations and mangas on clothing design and product development
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Nowadays, animation and manga have become part of our culture and have developed into industries with scale effect. Japan and America have had great influence on the development of Chinese animation and manga industry, while the values and aesthetics in the two countries are different from or even go against Chinese traditions. In China, most animation and manga lovers are teenagers. The animation and manga industry, as part of culture, is posing a huge impact on Chinese youth's ideology, social values and their taste of beauty, which will become one of the driving forces in forming their own cultural and aesthetic style in the mid-21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> century. This aesthetics can be most directly represented in teenagers' clothing style and it will influence the clothing product design and development.

articleTitle: Analysis of human factors in bed design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: According to ergonomic theory, it analyzed structure of human body, human behavioral habits when using bed and other human factors, and then proposed specific design principles for each part of bed as well as environment for using it.

articleTitle: Application of computer aided technology on microgripper based on GMM design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In order to overcome the shortcomings of the present microgripper, a new type of microgripper based on GMM was presented. Microgripper based on GMM is a type of microgripper based on giant magnetostrictive material. Driving force is provided by the expansion and shrinkage of GMM in magnetic field. Using giant magnetostrictive material to drive microgripper can not only realize quick response and large output force, but also control output force easily. This paper showed that how to apply computer aided technology into microgripper based on GMM design. Application of 3D solid modeling based on KBE can optimize the design of microgripper construction. Microgripper magnetic field can be analyzed through CAE. Clamp simulation of microgripper can be realized through VRML. The application of computer aided technology in the new type of microgripper design may significantly reduce the microgripper's design cost and design cycle.

articleTitle: A study of ATM secure interaction on user-based
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In the recent past years, the widespread application of ATM has played a significant role in people's lives and brought about various problems as well. How to make the users use ATM in a secure and effective way has been a social problem to be urgently solved. The thesis focuses on secure interaction of ATM, that is the various dangers and disturbances in subjective psychology, on the base of which the discussion extends, the concept of ATM secure interaction is proposed and with the design principle of ATM secure interaction as the key point of the thesis, finally the summarized ATM design proposal was raised and it provides helpful guidance and reference for the related designs in the future.

articleTitle: Industrial product design in the vision of security
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This article gives analysis on industrial products from the angle of human safety. It points out that, as the medium between human beings and the outside world, industrial product plays an important role in the inevitable activities human beings taking part in. So, the research in the safety of industrial product design becomes necessary. The article discusses the direction of safety in product design as well as the responsibilities human beings must shoulder of their own safety. It also points out that three aspects of factors lead to the dialectic relationship between product and human safety. Industrial product is a tool for human beings to solve problems but also the cause of safety problems. Human beings should take advantage of the control over products they own now to direct products to benefit human beings.

articleTitle: Control and research on color regional planning of urban architectures—Taking Shuguang Road in Hangzhou as an example
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The generalized color-theory is applied to color planning and design of the urban architectures in this article with the purpose of studying the individual image from the macroscopic view, and regional color division from the microcosmic view; the control guidance of urban architectures color against different regions has been put forward following the principle of integrating the theory and practices. Site investigations on the architectures color in one region in Hangzhou were conducted by making the color analysis after converting the color samples into munsell color labeling parameter (HV/C). The corresponding conclusions are achieved, and the planning thought and regional color-matching guide rules are summarized. At last, rational application of color is applied to maintain and reshape the urban regional features and to make the planning for urban functional regions.

articleTitle: CI strategy of Chinese enterprises with the core of establishing identity
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the arrival of the information era and increasingly fierce international competition, many business management personnel and CI planners have to face a problem to introduce CI which is adapted to Chinese enterprises. This article focuses on the analysis of relevant issues challenged Chinese enterprises and the current situation of their CI strategies and elaborates the importance of identity to CI designs of Chinese enterprises from the fundamental functions of CI. It also introduces the strategies and methods adopted in establishing identity in CI designs from the aspects of visualization of core concept and visual unity and difference.

articleTitle: Inquiry into the shape design of display space based on visual perception
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Shape design of display space focuses mainly on embodiment of psychological and physical demand of visitors in design. Visitors' recognition, acceptance and acquisition to information supplied by exhibitors, to a large extent, are decided by people's visual perception to visual object. Research theory of Gestalt psychology and Arnheim has verified: the awareness of human visual perception to objective world is an active process of visual cognition. The article analyzes the relationship between the shape of display space and the organization of display space through correlated theories of visual perception, the relationship between space shape and visual perception, and the reaction characteristics of human vision to various visual inducements and discusses the application of human visual perception to display spatial shape design.

articleTitle: Research on interactive design on financial services based on bank self-assist platform
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the continuous development of the market economy, electronic financial services have influenced everyone's life. This new terminal service has become the main development goal of the financial industry because of its convenience, quickness and safety. But with the rapid growth of its size and the number, financial services interactive system have also revealed some shortcomings. For example, the instructions are too complex and the systems can not satisfy all kinds of customers. The design method of electronic interactive multimedia system of financial services the theory of UCD was analyzed in this paper. A relatively reasonable solution was proposed, and the future development orientation and application field of multimedia electronic financial services was researched. A reasonable development plan on the popularity and application of electronic interactive system of financial services was proposed relying on innovative design of industrial design.

articleTitle: Research on intelligent decision-making system for selecting development method of heavy oil reservoir
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Choosing the right development method is to determine whether or not the heavy oil reservoirs can development successfully. At present, the development method of heavy oil is decided by experts of heavy oil reservoir development. So, different experts may obtain different results, which can't avoid the subjectivity brought by experts. To the problem, the paper established an intelligent decision-making system applied expert system and neural network to select the development method of heavy oil reservoir intelligently. Expert system play the role of summarizing and working up experiential knowledge of heavy oil reservoir development by knowledge base and the role of simulating experts' thinking process by inference engine. In the knowledge of KB, the weight of the sensitivity parameters of the heavy oil reservoir that affect the selecting significantly can not be accurately man-made determined. The article introduced three lays of neural network system to obtain the trusty weight through training a large number of samples. The Intelligent decision-making system for selecting development method of heavy oil reservoir combined expert system and neural network not only make use of expert's valuable knowledge effectively, but also avoided the subjectivity brought by experts. The result of proven examples showed that the intelligent decision-making system can select the development method of heavy oil reservoir rapidly and scientifically.

articleTitle: An introduction to the recreative design of package material
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The recreative design of package material has become a new focus of modern package design. The material design will upgrade and extend the scope of designing, and bring more inspirations to designers. The shift of the emphasis in package design from words and shapes to materials and characteristics has offered designers more choices of materials and improved their ways of expressing themselves in designing. In this way package design become more diversified, which enriched the existing packaging market. This paper starts with an introduction to market demand and the forms and characteristics of recreative design, and illustrates the artistic techniques in recreative design, which combined and integrated various artistic forms into existing materials. In recreative designs, designers try to find characteristics of new materials and new visual effects of different materials. In this way, new materials are made from the old ones, and the package materials can better suit the cultural orientation of the product itself, making it stand out in the fierce market competitions.

articleTitle: Inspiration of Henry Moore's sculptures to fundamental modeling courses
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In fundamental modeling courses, it is very necessary to give some appreciation of Henry Moore's sculptures. We will discuss four revelations of his sculptures to the fundamental modeling education. We state that Moore's sculptures are helpful for students to comprehend abstract form, positive and negative relationship of space, how to get inspiration from nature and how to endow form with life.

articleTitle: The construction of VI design and modern enterprise culture image
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Enterprise culture is a enterprise image, is the soul of an enterprise, employees, improve enterprise image shows the important embodiment of brand strategy, is the enterprise is one of the important tasks of management. This article discusses VI vision identification system as an important part of enterprise culture and the construction of enterprise culture plays an important role in image at the same time, this paper further discusses the construction of enterprise culture by VI design approaches and methods of the image.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Entertainment products design research based on ice-snow culture
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Integration and acquisition: On the new trend of Taiwan's artistic design education
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Today, the cross-cultural, cross-regional, cross-age, multi-disciplinary international cultural integration makes design art more diversified and pluralized, which puts forward higher and new requirements for the education of artistic design. Integration and acquisition have been new trends of Taiwan's artistic design education in recent years. This paper analyzes and compares these new trends on Taiwan's artistic design education, and concludes that the diversity and pluralism of Taiwan's design art education and good transmission and integration are the main force to promote Taiwan creative industries.

articleTitle: The humanization design of dental facilities for children
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The humanistic love and care has been increasing with the society progress in the contemporary era. There are more concerns for children's health care and in particular psychology all the more. The text summarizes the characteristics and defects of dental facilities, and inquires into the train of thought on the design for children with the idea, people oriented as the basis. The application of humanistic design helps medics manipulate safely, efficiently and comfortably, and placate children for pain relief.

articleTitle: Auxiliary functions of geometrical forms in design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Geometrical forms have always been influencing the design in history, especially in modern design. This article tries to explore the origin and process of its development and the reasons for its trend to prosperity from the history on relationships among geometrical forms, proportions and aesthetics. This article also takes examples from famous designs of graphics, buildings and products to analyze them in details and emphasizes the indispensible auxiliary functions of geometrical forms in modern design.

articleTitle: The strategic research of traditional handicraft products' modern development bases on consumer psychology
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Basing on traditional handicraft products' development status, this thesis analyzes handicrafts' negative factors such as large design flexibility, complicated production process, weakness in development and detachment from the modern manufacturing system and so on. The thesis takes “Longquan sword” as an example to study the modern development strategy which bases on consumer psychology and combines with industrial design. Besides, it also discusses the development mode and combination of industrial design and traditional handicraft industry.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The application of Chinese garden art in the Campus Landscape—Zhejiang Tourism College Campus landscape design II
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research and development of the generation in Japanese manga based on frontal face image
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the development of computer graphics and non-photorealistic rendering, manga production has developed towards computer aided design. However, so far, there has not formed a CAD (Computer Aided Design) approach for manga simulation based on frontal face. So, in this study, we adopt the method such as Sobel algorithm, ASM (Active Shape Model) and curve fitting to generate the facial image of Japanese manga by converting reference image with frontal face into line drawing of head contour and inserting some template of facial expressions. Therefore, the CAD of Japanese manga based on reference image with frontal face can be realized.

articleTitle: Study on artistic characteristics of virtual exhibition
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: As a culture integrating technologies and arts, virtual exhibition delivers people's understanding to the world and imagination of the future. In the paper, a study on the artistic characteristics of virtual exhibition is done for the purpose of expressing and delivering exhibition information accurately by using rational cognition in the realization process of creation and design of virtual exhibition system and making its artistic representability and emotional persuasive power meet audiences' browse will more fully finally.

articleTitle: Spherical Bézier curve based on corner cutting
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The classical de Casteljau algorithm for constructing Bézier curves can be generalized to sphere of arbitrary dimension by replacing line segments with shortest great circle arcs. The resulting spherical Bézier curve is C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sup> and interpolates the endpoints of its control polygons. In this paper, a new method is proposed to construct spherical Bézier curves, which extends corner cutting method, introduced by Lane-Riesenfeld to sphere. The final curve created by this method converges to spherical Bézier curves named corner cutting spherical Bézier curves. The necessary and sufficient condition of G1 continuity for two spherical Bézier curves is presented. Finally, as a by-product geodesic can be created on free-form surfaces with presented approach.

articleTitle: Planning and Designing about Approached-water space of White river waterfront in Nanyang
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Planning and Designing about approached-water space of White river waterfront in Nanyang expounds mainly White river in Nanyang as public approached-water space lacking the attribute of approached-water, publication and safety. Aiming to referred insufficiency, plans and designs the embankment, waterfront trail, approached-water square,plant construction of Approached-water space and other issues about white river, settling the expectation of approaching and getting to water.

articleTitle: A research of train interior color design based on passenger experience
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Based on the passenger experience theory and the features of train interior design, the main evaluation factors in its color design are proposed and the functional and aesthetic factors are analyzed. The factors include the following points: how to Comply with train characteristics, increase the sense of space and stability , easy identification, color coordination, brand, culture and style. Article also proposes a train interior color design process, and the passengers experience evaluation is used as an important component in the design optimization.

articleTitle: The apparel higher education in China: Reform and development
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: China's apparel higher education has experienced significant transformations to accommodate the development of society and economy. One purpose of this paper is to review the current changes in apparel higher education through reform and reconstruction during the past two decades in a historical perspective. Another purpose is to identify the new challenges and problems met in terms of globalization, mass higher education, and higher technological revolution. Through analysis, the paper concludes that to produce graduates capable of participating and competing in the emerging global society, China apparel higher education should conduct complicated reform and reconstruction, including further international cooperation and exchanges, further computer application in curriculum, strengthening merchandising, marketing and global resourcing education, curricula updating and diversification, and seamless Linkage of knowledge of different major and specialization.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Inspiration of Chinese traditional culture to modern industrial design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Product robust design based on evolutionary algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The product robust design which based on evolutionary algorithm could improve the general degree of the products greatly, achieve maximum product function, and meet the diverse needs of users. The product characteristic matrix and the product's binary tree structure gene are formed by semantic analysis and hierarchical cluster analysis. Through crossover and mutated of the robust factor, robust population and using population, using evolutionary operator such as similarity, correlation, fitness equation to get the global optimal product design solution, which can ensure that product has no sensitivity and small fluctuations while being used in different environment, facing different user with different usage, and then the product could achieve strong robustness. The example of the high-heeled shoes shows that this method has better adaptability and innovativeness in product design.

articleTitle: The problems and solutions of residential waterscape design in Kunming
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Focuses on the problems of the current residential waterscape design in Kunming and its later maintenance stage, the author proposes some suggestions in order to bring some reference to the later residential waterscape design, trying to find out some proper solutions to guide the waterscape's future construction and maintenance.

articleTitle: A study on the application of Internet symbols under the context of Chinese culture in the product design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the development of computer network, the Internet culture generated based on Internet interaction has been increasingly paid attention to In the process of Internet cultural transmission, the transmission of Internet symbols is one of the important elements. The Internet world has rapid means of transmission with barrier-free transmission range, and these factors play a crucial role in the rapid spread of the Internet symbols. In the Chinese Internet culture, the Internet symbol under the context of Chinese culture is different from other Internet symbols. In the product design, how to apply the Internet symbols under the context of Chinese culture has positive significance to promote both Chinese culture and Chinese Internet culture. This paper mainly analyzes the Internet symbols, and takes a symbol in Chinese culture as the example to study and discuss the refinement and application of Internet symbols in the product design.

articleTitle: Application of computer image processing techniques on the research of silk air filter paper
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Computer image processing techniques were used to analyse the flocculation of silk fibers and the formation of paper, and to provide a basis for the improvement of the processing technology of silk air filter paper. The results showed that there was a good corresponding relationships between the flocculation characteristics of silk fibers and the formation, the pore size distribution and the air permeability of its paper. When the beating degree was 30<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>SR, the flocculation of silk pulp was severe, and the formation of its paper was very poor, the minimum pore size area of its paper was 7.41 ∼9.11µm, and the pore size and the air permeability of its paper was very large. With the increase of the beating degree, the flocculation of silk pulp decreased, and the formation of its paper was improved and its pore size decreased. When the beating degree of silk pulp reached 50<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>SR, the minimum pore size area of its paper was 2.21∼2.82µm, and the proportion of pores size ranging from 2.21 to 6.36µm was 98.53%, the pore size distribution of its paper was better, and the air permeability of its paper decreased,but it could still meet with the requirements of air filter paper.

articleTitle: Researches on interactive design of touch-screen mobile TV software interface based on CMMB technology
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: the rapid development of mobile internet facilitates the popularization and convenience in access to the internet by individual mobile equipments. More and more people are using individual mobile equipments for realizing specific functions: such as browsing web pages, watching TV, searching information which used to be realized in specific location and so on. Since more and more people are using mobile phones to watch TV, design of touch-screen mobile TV software interface has been designed consequently. This dissertation mainly focuses on the research of interactive design of touch-screen mobile TV software interface based on CMMB technology. Proceeding from the human-oriented design concept, real user model was established and the prototype of touch-screen mobile TV software interface was designed.

articleTitle: The study on hydraulic system of roller mill
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The performance of hydraulic system plays an important role in roller mill. The hydraulic system was regarded as a vibration system with a single degree-of-freedom and the differential equation of roller was derived on the basis of the analysis of piston movement. It was found that the dynamic performance is affected by the damping ration, which depends on the performance of the hydraulic oil and the cross-section of the hydraulic tube, and the stiffness which is influenced by the pressure and the volume of accumulator. The damping ratio has a great effect on the response amplitude and the force-delivering ratio, but the stiffness only affects the response amplitude. The simulation on the hydraulic system of a roller mill designed to crush limestone was performed using Matlab. The result has shown that the system reached the steady state in 2s when step excitation was applied and in 1s when impulse excitation was applied.

articleTitle: Research on the quick proofing process of carton
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Article describes a kind of the quick proofing process of carton. The digital mode of the quick proofing process of carton is scientific practical and accuracy, which is based on computer-aided design (CAD) technology. It can design carton Structure profile, which can be virtually proofed in the software. Combined digital proofing with digital mould technology, it can build a integration mode of software and hardware of carton device . Using the program to drive carton device,it can be realized that the digital proofing and cutting and creasing process of carton.

articleTitle: Design and research of SNS users network structure model based on pervasive computing
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the further development of the network and information technology, the SNS websites established on the theory of Six Degrees of Separation appear rapidly, and the trend presents explosively. Their appearances prove that there is some of the same between physical world & virtual world. Its interpersonal relationship networking brings interpersonal communication and information broadcasting into a period of social networking. This article is based on the theory of pervasive computing, models the SNS network structure through J2ME (CLDC/MIDP) & TWaver. Also, this article analyzes the communication channels and the classification models of information vividly.

articleTitle: A study on teaching method of reverse analysis in web animation design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: One of the major problems of teaching and research is how to make the students acquire the correct way of thinking and to explore the suited teaching method. In this paper, we study the teaching method of web animation program according to the existing courses and teaching problems, perfect the teaching content and highlight the gravity by carrying out the inverse way of thinking “from static to dynamic” to foster students, and develop the students' innovative way of thinking and the operating skills by applying “reverse demo”. The aim of the transformation of methods and tools is to let them master this course systematically and then creatively carry out the design in web animation.

articleTitle: The research of global design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Nowadays, everyone pay attention to globalization, which range from environment to economic and culture. It is a huge challenge to face an international market. The relationship in economic and culture between German and China has become more and more important. Unfortunately, the recognition of each other is relatively not enough, which prevent the cooperation in project or product development. The project aims at the research on functional innovational product design and development. The team combines students from German and China, which proposes for the design and manufacture of functional product. Along with the grasually improving living standard, more and more equipments for exercise can be seen in public place. on one hand, designers consider from the view of users, they hope to meet the fitness of people during the exercise through design; on the other hand, they use Chinese elements appropriately, so that design work could adapt to its geographical environment.

articleTitle: Comparison research on residential environment between hall and study in south of the Yangtze River
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: As an important part of Confucianism, etiquette system culture was influenced on people's life and residential environment. Comparing residential environment between hall and study showed contrast effect that varied from etiquette system of value, such as solemn and leisure, systematic and personalized. Design of study space indicates the idea of “human-centered” and personalization lifestyle of literati, which can be regarded as the tendency of successful Chinese traditional interior design.

articleTitle: The meaning of the form : Discrimination of modern design features
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Modern design, as a kind of survival form of creativity, is undoubtedly a “significant form”. Making a correct understanding and comprehensive discrimination on modern design features is a prerequisite for effective design, and is also the basis for sustained development of modern design. This paper makes specific analysis of modern design features through explaining the special meaning of modern design in the material, activities, concept and other aspects. Then it proposes that the purposes of use significance, the integration of practical significance, the advance of cognitive significance, and so on, are the fundamental features of modern design. In addition, deeply discusses the concrete manifestations and attributes constitutes of these features.

articleTitle: The preliminary understanding to the characterization of cultural phenomenon
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Based on the Tianjin Shi courtyard as an example, this paper analysis auspicious patterns elements of Chinese traditional culture, gets the preliminary understanding of Chinese cultural connotation and discusses the necessary of native design contained in traditional culture to keeping pace with the times and the method of design.

articleTitle: Swept volumes of toroidal cutters using generating curves based on the polar coordinates
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Modelling the volume swept by a tool as it moves from one programmed position to another in the polar coordinates machining is a challenging task. In this paper, a technique for generating the volume swept by a toroidal cutter in its motion along a given tool path, is presented. This technique is based on identifying “generating curves” along the path and connecting them into a solid model of the swept volume. The swept volume simulations are verified experimentally for a test piece. These are also compared with the simulation results from the Z-map technique. The results of the experimental verification show the method to be accurate to within 1 mm for the three test pieces. It is concluded that the proposed method has the potential of allowing fast simulation and verification of tool path on a polar coordinates.

articleTitle: A new coding method
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The principle of “waveform invariance” is used for velocity measurement of the correlation sonar, which has a bottom tracking capability for providing earth reference velocity. For earlier two-pulse sonar systems, trade-offs were made between maximum range and velocity variance due to the reason that pulse width is equal to or less than pulse repetition period.
