A new pulse coding technique for a single transmitted pulse is utilized in the paper with respect to the conflicting problem mentioned above. The method involves truncated Gold sequence which contains the same number of 0's and 1's. The nature of the coded pulse is such that the autocorrelation function of the pulse possesses a temporal autocorrelation peak at a predetermined time lag besides at 0.The method used will increase achievable range while velocity accuracy not be deteriorated because correlation delay is less than pulse width.

articleTitle: On the influence of CAD on landscape design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: CAD (Computer Aided Design) has become the indispensable element in performing design work, by virtue of its high precision, high efficiency, true-to-nature effect, and being easy to modify. In the field of landscape design, CAD will make a big difference in site analysis, design concept, and graphics presentation, etc. Designers can save time for the the spatial character and form design. CAD provides unparalleled convenience to the major of landscape design, making site design come natural to the designers, communication in design more smooth and direct.

articleTitle: On constructing a virtual museum of mining and metallurgy culture in Huangshi, China
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This paper, through analyzing the development trend of heritage museums and the current situation of exhibiting mining and metallurgy heritages in Huangshi China, proposes scientific ideas and methods to guide the construction of a virtual museum of mining and metallurgy culture, and expresses the profound realistic and historical significance of it for the preservation and presentation of mining and metallurgy heritages. This paper is also of certain referential values for carrying forward the mining and metallurgy culture, rescuing and preserving heritages, and cultivating distinctive local cultural tourist industry.

articleTitle: Current design course and the teaching of specialized courses
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: During the past, the aspects of educational system, curriculum design and teaching of Chinese Art Design was not as specific as today. At present, because curriculums design of some universities specializing in designing is overly to satisfy market demand, its overdone specification leads to the imprecise specification between teachers and students, and the ineffective attention to transnational work among designing courses. As a result, students' creative thought cannot be improved positively. According to the discussion above, focusing on the connected problems between basic lessons and professional lessons, the author talks about his understand as well as experience during teaching process, hoping to be helpful for quality improvement of designing education and extension of students' conception.

articleTitle: Innovation design of pencil sharpener
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Innovation design is the core strategy in the business competition. The innovation design of a new type pencil sharpener is investigated in this article by taking three factors which consist of beautiful, fun and environmentally friendly into consideration. The main design idea is to use discarded Coke bottle as a pencil sharpener chip flute to cater to the harmonious society of duplication of resources utilization and environmental protection, while using some other interesting elements to enhance environmental protection awareness of children and train children to develop the good habit of treasure time.

articleTitle: Exploring the cultural connotation of innovation in furniture design from the perspective of technology
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This paper aims to interpret the cultural essence of innovation activities in furniture design, with a new perspective of science and technology, rather than art. it analyzed the external performance, internal motivation, as well as the reason of innovation in furniture design. Firstly, innovative application of new materials is a particularly prominent aspect in furniture design. New materials calls for new structure, and promote the evolution of styles. Secondly, technical advancements provide us with new materials, structures, processing techniques. Finally, technical advancements change our lifestyles by changing our technical concepts as well as aesthetic values.

articleTitle: Toy design matched with children of target age
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Analyzing the company's development process and the real situation, the essay focuses on finding differences between what products offer and what children need. Due to the mismatching of supply and demand, suggestion of product matching age is proposed that preschool children should be divided into different groups. A series of problems were discovered during the study of recent toy market, including unclear age definition, vague product concept and inappropriate function sets. The essay also studies different design methods according to the features of children in different age. Therefore, designers should focus more on children's needs and their unique characteristics when designing products.

articleTitle: Research on evaluation system of user-centered LED garden lamp design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Besides the appearance design of lamps themselves, the lighting should meet the basic distribution requirements. Additionally, the resource consumption and the influence of LED lamps on the environment should be considered. The big change in the system of the concept and evaluation of LED garden lamp design is turned out accordingly. It means that landscape lighting lamp design should be based on people's requirements and the lamp design should be considered as a whole. The focus on the lamp design gradually transfers from the pursuit of lamp functions and appearance to humanized pursuit of user-centered LED garden lighting lamp design. How to extent the concept of functional design of LED garden lighting, and how to comprehensively design user-centered LED garden lighting lamps are the key issues that LED garden lighting design should solve firstly. According to users' real needs, factors of quantity, appearance and impression in the evaluation system of LED garden lamp design are discussed in this paper. Good LED garden lamp design should equip with good light distribution curve, and additionally design proper lamp structure which integrates into the environment as a whole.

articleTitle: Research of wood plastic composite in the design and application of emergency houses
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Under the background of frequent earthquake disasters, taking advantage of good earthquake resistance and other excellent characteristics of wood plastic composite (WPC), systematically research it in the design and application of emergency houses. Meanwhile, the appearance, function and cultural connotation of the house are analyzed by modular design in combination of Chinese traditional culture, to solve the existing problems like single functional space, poor living condition, hard recycling process, lack of recognition and privacy, etc. It is also environment friendly, low carbon and sustainable, and will get some practical significance.

articleTitle: PDA design based on embedded Linux
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the further development of the computer network, the revolution of the OS and the popularization of network transmission technology, PDA has been an important upsurge in IT business for its small size, low energy consumption, powerful functions and easy exploiting. Meanwhile, the embedded system technology has infiltrated into all fields of the society. Linux has more development space in embedded systems thanks to its great performance in high end servers and the characteristic of open source and service-oriented. Therefore, PDA development based on embedded Linux has been the hotspot for many researchers. In order to further exploit the development process of PDA and improve the design in the practical level, we studied the development process of the PDA tools on the ARM-Linux platform in the case of address book design. This paper first introduced the development overview and main application of PDA in various fields, then presented the embedded Linux development platform and the experiment setup, furthermore, we chose Qt as the graphics development toolkit for this paper and made detailed description for the design and implementation of the address book.

articleTitle: The flow and aerodynamic noise calculation of a generic side mirror
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The flow and aerodynamic noise of a generic side mirror in high-speed is evaluated using numerical simulation and experiment. The Reynolds number is Re = 5.2 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> basing on the mirror diameter. Transient flow field is analyzed by Large Eddy Simulation (LES), two different sub-grid scale (SGS) models named Smagorinsky-Lilly (SL) and Wall-Adapting Local Eddy-viscosity (WALE) are used to express the turbulent viscosity. Detailed velocity vectors and pressure fluctuation contours are compared by cut planes in the flow-field. Mean and transient pressure are also monitored at several points in the flow field and compared with corresponding experimental data. The sound propagation is predicted by the Ffowcs Williams-Hawkings (FW-H) acoustic analogy where wall pressure fluctuations and pressure temporal are treated as two source terms. The conclusion is that the SL model is a better candidate for this mirror simulation.

articleTitle: Design elements in jewelry design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Jewelry usually denotes necklace, earring and ring etc. Jewelry not only can remedy garments perfectly but also can reveal region, cultural and times feature. The design of jewelry belongs to the category of industrial design. On elaborating design essential factors this paper has made a series of complete necklace, bracelet and ring. It is showing that excellent jewelries have characters and are works of art combined perfectly by design and technology.

articleTitle: Acquisition of product form perceptual image information and establishment of information database system based on Web
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Improved design was mainly adopted in the form design of electromechanical products, based on the information customers' percept about the form perceptual image of case products. On the basis of deconstruction of case products form, the construction process of composition of product form system elements, the structural form among elements, and the product form image space were introduced in this study. Mathematical models of product form system and form perceptual image space were put forward to build the information base framework of customers' perception about product form image was built, the development method for the information base system was proposed based on Web technology. The family car styling was taken as an example to illustrate application of this system.

Author Keywords: information base of product form perceptual image

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Victory of copying: Exploring the design way in the age of popular culture
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The application of the media materials in public art in the context of the digital age
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In this paper, the background of digital age is briefly analysed, and then it illustrates the development of media materials in public art on terms of both traditional and digital age. Afterwards, it future researches the application of media materials in public art through the case study of materials related to imaging, photoelectric, inductive and composite in the context of the digital age.

articleTitle: The creation and interpretation of visual image in product animation
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the approach of “eyeball” economy era, product animation is playing an increasingly role of cultural mediation in brand communication. Therefore, visual image becomes the guide of visual form, the communicator of brand information, the interpreter of aesthetic emotion in product animation gradually. This thesis starts with three aspects which are the nature of image, the cognitive basis of image and image build to analyze focus on image build method which base on culture innovative thinking. Expatiate on the introduction of dynamic visual arts, cognitive theory, and traditional aesthetic cultural into technical aspects of animation. Takes diversification and multi-dimension as value orientation, takes the fine cultural tradition as aesthetic orientation to improve cultural of product animation to a new level, and creates more animation product with vivid image.

articleTitle: Interpretation of parametric design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This paper discusses the parametric design for the architectural field. In the field of architectural design, parametric design is another design revolution based on technical updates after the Modern Architecture Movement, and it is increasingly paid close attention to relying on its new way of thinking and good ability to solve complex design problems. Parametric design covers three levels: the parametric technology as a design tool, the way of thinking hidden in the parametric technology, and the design style created by this way of thinking and the technology.

articleTitle: The data structure and realization model of product style derivation
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Firstly, the vector method of the product shape feature is further studied based on that the product can be separated into the feature subassemblies and the subassembly is shown by several characteristic pixel points. Secondly, the data structure of product style, the one that fits style derivation, is presented using the normalized product style description - the three-dimensional cognitive space based on Multi-Dimensional Scaling (MDS). Thirdly, the realization model of product style derivation is explored deeply on the basis of Subassembly Shape-Para Prototype Square Matrix (SSPPSM) and Subassembly Style Contribution Rate Square Matrix (SSCRSM) proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: An exploration of energy-saving green products design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In light of the growing problem of global warming, resource depletion, air pollution and other environmental problems, by analyzing the excessive use of fossil fuels, and the drawbacks of product design without considering energy consumption, this paper points out the importance of green energy-saving products design and explores the types of energy-saving green products.

articleTitle: The design teaching based on design practices in comprehensive universities
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The practice-based design education is a common feature in design education. The art design teaching include two parts: theory education and practice education. How to construct the system of practice teaching is an core issue. This paper outlined a study of practice types in use about design, then it analyzed and summarized some principles about practice-based design roundly. At last, the effect of practice education was discussed and evaluated objectively.

articleTitle: Green architecture: Traditional architecture rejuvenated from green design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The concept of green architectural design is briefly described in this article. The elaboration of how to apply technological methods of green design to traditional architecture to make the buildings alive can further illustrate the point that the green architectural design is a combination of traditional architectural design and the concept of the green design. The paper also explores what factors should be taken care of in the green design plan. The article briefly analyzes some technological methods that can be applied to modification of existing buildings for energy saving.

articleTitle: Study on automobile conceptual design based on the integration of organic and inorganic elements
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: An innovative automobile conceptual design method based on integrated organic and inorganic elements is presented in this paper. The practicability and perceptiveness of method have been verified in the process of an automobile conceptual design. This method has an important reference value for enhancing the design efficiency and quantizing variance in automobile styling design.

Author Keywords: integration of organic and inorganic elements

articleTitle: Reverse solution for discrete beam dynamics parameter of leaf spring with variable stiffness based on the simulated annealing-genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In order to simulate the dynamic characteristics of the real leaf spring, a dynamic model of leaf spring is set up in ADAMS/View with the application of discrete beam theory. Considering the difficulty of setting the exact dynamic parameters of discrete beam, ADAMS/Insight is used to analyze the sensitivity of these parameters. Then, simulated annealing-genetic algorithm is used to solve these reverse variables which are determined by the analyzed results. Finally, the effective of the method is validated in a reverse solution calculation example of leaf spring with variable stiffness for the rear suspension of a vehicle.

articleTitle: Study on the interactive relationship between specialized market and industrial clusters of textiles and clothing in China
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to explore how the textiles and clothing industry cluster and specialized market influence each other. This research observed and documented a case study of industry development in Changshu of Jiangsu province. Through the analysis, the researchers summarized the factors that account for significantly improvement of competiveness of clothing industry in Changshu. The research indicates that the relationship between industrial cluster and specialized market is interdependent and mutually promotive. As the industry is one pillar of China's economy, it's important to study this interactive mechanism for further growth of the industry in a global competition situation.

articleTitle: On the amplification and fabrication of the ordinary daily life by contemporary artistic innovation—Enlightment of Benjamin
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In this era of our living, the image arts, such as the photography, video, films, have been become both an important form of contemporary art and a way for artists to show themselves. It had been known to us for the view of Benjamin in the paper after reading his article of “artistic works in the age of mechanical reproduction”. Furthermore, it had been discussed on his view in many ways such as the traditional movie art, pop art, and modern image arts. It was true that the contemporary artistic innovation could wave fundamentally the concept of traditional arts and extend or amplify the daily life, at last it copy the daily life.

articleTitle: Experience design & application Animation
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In the current economic situation, how to enhance the added values of products are important issues to enterprises and designers. In the process of production economic restructuring to the experience economic, providing high-quality end-user production experience is becoming into focus of industrial design. Application Animation has broad application prospects. It is good visual communication way for product's UI, Product Popularization, research, archaeological, TV Packing, Architecture plan representation and so on. User could get good experience about products by application Animation.

articleTitle: Demonstration research on college students' preference on product form style
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Based on theory of coherence of self-concept of self-concept, this paper discusses the psychology evaluation of college students' self-concept. By evaluating their self-concept, college students' preference on product form styling can be conferred. This approach of this research should be helpful to enterprise when making Product Positioning.

articleTitle: Implicit and explicit interaction in RFID technology application
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The Radiofrequency Identification (RFID) technology has brought a revolution to the information framework and the intelligent living environment. Nowadays it is necessary to analyze the interaction behavior between the RFID application device and users. Adapting RFID technology brings advantages and convenience for people's life, however due to further RFID utilization obstacle, limitation and collision phenomenon appears to be real problems. Technology development is the driving force to lead the industry, apparently the primary interaction mode affected by the functionalism need to be inspected and enrich to meet the request of new challenge within a more pervasive application. We analyze the implicit and explicit interaction mode in RFID application and propose a modification in existing interaction pattern between transponder and tag, reader and user, user and tag.

articleTitle: The application and research of fractal unit design in product modeling design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Based on the fractal theory, recognize the new design language - fractal unit design, understand the normal source elements and morphological evolution laws of fractal unit design, Interpret the impact of fractal unit design theory on product modeling design. According to the fractal self-similarity, induce five typical morphological evolution laws, and take examples about their uses in product modeling design.

articleTitle: The humanized design of children furniture
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Based on children's furniture design problems as the starting point, the humanized concept in the new era under the environment of the new explanation, and pointed out that new humanized principle in children furniture design method of implementation, the current situation of children furniture industry, puts forward some advice.

articleTitle: Community landscape design for meeting the needs of older persons
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the advent of an aging society, community landscape design should pay attention to the psychological aspects of the elderly population besides the physiology. We analysis the general psychological characteristics of elderly people and explore their demands, raise and investigate issues in the community landscape design which should be attached importance to on the purpose to create a good environment for living landscape and build a harmonious community environment.

articleTitle: Research on the recycling packaging materials
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: For modern packing industry, making environmental packages is a tendency. Nowadays it has proved recycling materials to be the capital choice element on packing. Packing material is inseparable from design, and also it is the base of the design. Moreover, that is the last way which transforms the design from sense of sight to an entity and realizing environmental protection. Kinds and quality of materials are the standards by which we can measure whether they are eco-friendly. Saving resources and effective degradation is the best method to keep on a development and avoid pollution. Furthermore, energy conversions make the maximal action of resources. Only if we recognize the form of packaging materials can we make full use of it to the environmental-friendly design.

articleTitle: The algorithm analysis and program implementation of sphere model
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Sphere model is widely used in many areas. By analyzing the characteristic of sphere model, this paper builds one kind of data structure for sphere model based on computer graphics, and use computer program to simulate it. This data structure is uncomplicated and being handled easily, the data transmission and computer processing speed are improved greatly with little calculation.

articleTitle: The study on priority-based location display in OPAC system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In order to provide user more accurate location of the book, we add the function of displaying location by dynamic 3D graphics and highlighting the bookshelf which the target book on to the existing system of OPAC. But the amount of information which is needed in the progress of importing model files presented to the user through Java3D is very large, and for reducing the data size of transmission, we bring in borrow priority in this paper, and define that it's only the user who has the priority can check the dynamic 3D graphics of the target book.

articleTitle: Overview of artificial emotion in music
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Due to the essential features of music emotion, affective computing research in the field of music can accomplish much. And it is becoming a hot issue in the field of artificial intelligence and multimedia. This paper analyses the forms and contents of affective computing research, and focus on the content of the three specific researches: computer music emotion recognition, emotional semantic-driven music retrieval, emotional music synthesis technology. Finally, this paper concludes the possible future research directions.

articleTitle: Review of research and development status of community mutual assistance services system for Senior citizen
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The article firstly summarized several problems in the design by analyzing the current development status of community mutual assistance services system for Senior citizen; and then highlighted the necessity of conducting the deep research in focus on the senior citizen life style as well as the community overall environment and the macroscopic environment in future research and development of services system, based on which designer can develop a service system that meets the senior citizen needs, communities and policy environment.

articleTitle: Practice in the innovation design of traditional craft products—With the example of Longquan Swords
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Through the design of innovative services of Longquan Swords Products, the opportunities and challenges of the development of Chinese traditional industries is summed up and analyzed and specific measures are proposed that the use of industrial design transforms and upgrades Chinese traditional industries based on practical experience.

articleTitle: Innovation packaging design of Anji dried bamboo shoots
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Innovation design is the core strategy in the business competition, and the main purpose of which is to incentive the special preferences of consumers. Thus, consumers can be successfully stimulated to purchase. The major objective of this paper is to investigate the method to enhance the competitiveness of manufacturing enterprises by differentiation strategy, which including design concept, molding-making design, decoration design, and so on. The authors deeply discuss and researches on packaging decoration design of Anji dried bamboo shoots and design three series of products: gifts, leisure foods and cuisine series. The innovative design is conducted in accordance with the theory of differentiation, which is integrated well into the packaging design of Anji dried bamboo shoots.

articleTitle: A new interactively experience based on multi-touch technology
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Based on the explore of existing products using multi-touch interactive mode operation, research the characteristics of input methods, and also consider the multi-touch interactive systems user's behavior, to analyze and summarize the feasibility and necessity of multi-touch interaction used in daily information products; explain the enormous impact caused by multi-touch which natural way of interaction to our daily life, combined with existing multi-touch technology to prospects its future on using methods and fields.

articleTitle: Study on driving behavior in emergency
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This paper analyzed the need of driving behavior study in emergency. The current research on driving behavior was reviewed. Driver's cognitive model and control model in emergency were explored. The content and technical line of in emergency situations was described. The prospect of its research was presented.

articleTitle: Interaction-oriented creative design for everyday product sign
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to present interaction-oriented creative design strategies and processes for everyday product sign. Based on the semiotic triangle of product sign, our work explored the interaction relations between user-product sign-human and interaction process, outlined the triangular relationship of interaction and the systemic interaction process model. The results suggest that interaction in design involves social interaction, user-product interaction and human-product interaction, and involves macro interaction process and micro interaction process (cognition, affect and behavior). Based on these, our work offered interaction-oriented creative design strategies and processes, and presented two everyday product design cases. These strategies and processes are very useful for enhancing designers' creative performances as well as enhancing satisfactory judgments of users' to product sign.

articleTitle: Chinese elements of cross-border study
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In the new era, art designs by the form itself and its load of information has been far from being able to meet the needs of the audience. Traditional and old-fashioned idea of the creative form of expression has been gradually fading out of the creative arena, and become a new favorite among the diversified media is used in the design work. This compels us to the design elements and the environment maintained a deep excavation and deep analysis of the creative intent, which formed in the creative design of the visual effects benign, the market effect and the effect of the humanities

articleTitle: Traditional design elements in Chinese MMORPG
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Network game art is a kind of digital interactive art, also a unique cultural form. This paper described the style and characteristics of Chinese MMORPG game mainly from the aspect of visual design, analyzed the extraction and applications of the ancient Chinese traditional elements, summarized the existing deficiencies, provided suggestions and references for designers, and tried to explore creative digital art design with rich cultural connotation.

articleTitle: A research on the market of Chinese brands of sportswear accessories and their designs
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In sportswear accessories market in China, the competition is in keen environment. The famous brands having stationed in foreign countries, occupy a large market share, and are in domination, although some Chinese sportswear accessories brands promote faster and have made significant improvement in this business conditions. But on the whole, China sportswear accessories enterprises are still vulnerable. This article, basis on the survey by four groups of market research and analysis, is to identify problems and solutions and studies on the sportswear accessories market. From the market needs, brand design differences can find out the key points for the entire sportswear accessories market. For the problems such as product design series is in a low level, the article studies on the expansion ways of China brand sportswear accessories in their variety, enhancing the product series design, creating personalized brands.

articleTitle: Topology optimization designing and performance testing of micro-clamp using meshless method
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In order to matches the large-displacement character of the compliant mechanisms, a nonlinear optimization method for designing micro-clamps is presented by combining the theory of element-free Galerkin method(EFGM) and topology optimization. The performance of the micro-clamp produced according to the design result is tested. The structural response analysis and sensitivity analysis are carried out by using EFGM, which matches the natural geometrically nonlinear behavior of micro-clamp. According to the topologies designed by linear and nonlinear meshless methods, two kinds of micro-clamps are produced. The force-displacement responses of the micro-clamps are then tested. And the result shows that the nonlinear EFGM is better for designing compliant micro-clamps than the linear EFGM.

articleTitle: The research of teaching reform on Ergonomics course for environmental art design specialty
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The teaching theory content and the methods of Ergonomics course were improved, which were based on teaching system and the characteristics of environmental art design specialty. With analysing the importance of Ergonomics course in environmental art design specialty, the status was concluded that current teaching was lack of complete practical process and arrangement of individualized instruction. The teaching effects can be improved by enforcing the specialty pertinence, adding the practical process, selecting the typical case. In the end, the validity of teaching reform schemes was verified by practice.

articleTitle: Some thought about the discussion of teaching in terms of design history
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Proceeding from the status quo of teaching in the perspective of design history, this article analyses the existing problems in actual teaching and puts forward some solutions so as to arouse the attention on discussion of teaching in design history.

articleTitle: The game expression of product design in low-carbon economy era
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The paper explores and analyzes the game expression problem of Chinese future product design under the background of the low-carbon economic development in current times of globalization. In low-carbon economy era, as the primary focus of consumers gradually shifts from material to spiritual, the concept of product design will shift from function to game. The paper explains the cultural functions of product design in low-carbon economy era based on its social functions, and suggests that the Chinese product design should seize the opportunity of the era changes. Incorporate traditional culture into product design by the game manner and form the Chinese design style with culture and national spirit, the significance of this research is important.

articleTitle: Discussion of developing Chinese design education from three aspects
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: On the basis of analysis of education of industrial design and the actuality of our country, this article proposes that the bottleneck of industrial design education in China is the absence of internal qualities of designer and shortage of the application of the research in social science. In order to change the state and develop, we must make some progress in the three aspects. First, new technique has to be integrated with the traditional skill under the development of technology and society. Second, great attention is paid to the internal qualities of designer. Third, the application of society science research must be thought highly of.

articleTitle: How to develop divergent thinking of students in industrial design teaching
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The paper gradually discusses how to use comparative teaching method and research learning mode to develop student's divergent thinking ability and future to develop student's creative ability by proposing issues such as-why divergent thinking ability shall be developed, issue analysis- factors may influence divergent thinking ability development, solutions- how to develop student's divergent thinking ability.

articleTitle: Research on humanized design for induction cooker
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Humanization is an important factor to make product competitive in modern fierce market. This paper analyzed the traditional design process and summarized elements in humanized product design, including function, modeling, color, material and interface. As a study case, a survey on induction cooker task requirement was designed to investigate users' demand, and then the product map chart was gained according to the analysis results of this survey. The conceptual and embodiment design process of induction cooker was illustrated to show a practical application for humanized product design. The prototype of induction cooker was made by rapid prototype technology. Factors concerned with human were considered and realized in the design.

articleTitle: Research and software design of coal mine equipment MIS based on MIS/GIS
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Owing to the inherited shortcomings of coal mine equipment management, coal mine equipment MIS based on VB and ASP.NET was designed, all data was integrated uniformly in the whole enterprises, realtime, remote, dynamic control and management of coal mine equipment was realized. By adopting the design of the MIS, productivity has been greatly improved; maintenance cost can be reduced, so as to management level and economical benefits have been improved.

articleTitle: Research on the key technology of product design on basis of Six Sigma
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Through researching the key technology of product design, this paper put Six Sigma, which is a brand-new management mode, into new product design. It applies the DFSS to improve the product design flow, and also uses some research methods, such as flow chart, Pareto Chart, KANO, etc., to preliminarily construct the DFSS which is used in product designing. It offers a certain reference in promoting the correct development of product design and the improvement of design flow, enhance the efficiency of product development and improve the quality of design. It verifies the practical significance of Six Sigma in approaching or avoiding risks happening in new product development by actual design cases.

articleTitle: The appropriate design of original ecological based on native
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The process of urbanization continues to accelerate, making the increasingly severe environmental problems, Garden design in the main object of extensive contact between a human and natural activities have been focused on the creative, Landscape designers are also faced with ethical rethinking. This paper put forward a timely manner from an environmental point of ethics, “the original eco-moderate garden” as a new concept, From the “original eco-garden design” positioning, form, value, the theoretical basis, practical significance, cultural and consumer psychology to start, To fully tap the Chinese classical gardens in the outstanding ecological and cultural and ethical philosophy, Landscape design activities will be promoted to the ecological justice, environmental ethics level, in order to solve the garden over the design and identical phenomenon, put forward the original ecological landscape design approach to explore a native culture with Chinese characteristics “of the original ecological landscape design” development.

articleTitle: Significance of creative industry clusters on development of industrial design in Wuhan
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Industrial clusters have become a very important mode of industrial development nowadays and clusters are of great significance in enhancing competitiveness and innovation capability. In Wuhan such a leading city of “Rise of Central China” Program, development of creative industry is still weak and industrial design is also in the early stage. This paper compared and analyzed the present situation of creative industry clusters and development of industrial design in Wuhan, and then summed up the significance of creative industry clusters on development of industrial design. The paper also put forward the idea of promoting the development of industrial design through industrial clusters in furniture, household goods, small commodities, etc.

articleTitle: Difpainter: Take image difference as paint in digital painting
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: To introduce real materials into digital painting, the interactive digital painting system “Difpainter” is proposed. The rudiment of this system is the calculation of difference between images captured from video camera. The system first captures two images from video camera, and then calculates the difference of the two and yields foreground image, finally paint target image with the foreground image by alpha blending technology. This process is executed iteratively; the parameters are configured through graphic user interface. The system enables using webcam to practice “Light Painting” and some other novel painting skills. This research enriches the skills of digital painting, improves the user experience, and presents novel visual effects.

articleTitle: Research in the structure and form of brand image of high-speed railway
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: As what has been recognized by most enterprises, for the process of migrating from OEM (Original Equipment Manufacture) to ODM (Original design Manufacture) and becoming OBM (Own Branding Manufacturing) finally, OBM is the top for a pyramid. Therefore, brand is the highest level of competition. Constructing brand of high-speed railway is distinct from that of general pattern of products. The constitutive relations of brand image of high-speed railway are analyzed at three aspects. Through analyzing the product composition of high-speed railway, the result shows that the key of constructing and sustaining the brand is the novel experience provided by innovative design of high-speed railway for passengers. Based on this, the strategies in connection with running domestic railway brand have been formulated.

articleTitle: A system enables pattern DIY for apparel
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: A pattern design system is proposed, to encourage average persons to design patterns on their apparel by themselves. The system firstly acquires video images, then constructs tiling, finally maps the tiling to some certain shape of apparel and displays it. This process is configured by users through GUI. The system allows generating patterns from everyday objects by simply shooting the objects. The interaction with the system was praised to be interesting. The generated patterns were multifarious and funny. The system also achieved WYSWYG-what you see is what you get.

articleTitle: Research on product design quality control methods based on QFD
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Product design quality control is one of the important functions of design management. We must carry out design control to design activity in order to achieve the design goal. Through the research on the Quality Function Deployment (QFD) method, this paper proposes that product quality control of design should start from the conceptual design stage. QFD converts user requirements into the relevant technical requirements of design, avoiding the decoupling phenomenon in the development process of new products. The core content of QFD is the conversion for requirement. House of Quality (HOQ) express the true quality of customer requirements systematically and the relationship between with characteristics of quality with language. According to the basic principles of QFD and HOQ, this paper analyses the influencing factors of product design quality, and its object and method. The process of design quality control is proposed finally.

articleTitle: Interpretation of materials and decorative wood flooring
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Comprehensive understanding of knowledge and the structure of wood flooring materials and construction, grasp the nature of wood and floor selection method, complex variety of decorative materials in front of varieties, so that we no longer hesitant, and fewer mistakes.

articleTitle: Application and research of traditional blue-and-white elements in modern packaging design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the rapid development of world economy, the national nature and commodity nature in modern packaging design are supplemented each other, and while the modern package is protecting products, transferring message and promoting sales, the modern package also transfers the spiritual connotation of the Chinese traditional aesthetic culture and the modern packaging design. In the splendid Chinese art and culture resources, blue-and-white porcelain is constantly praised by Chinese people and focused by the world as one of the Chinese traditional art and culture treasures, and how to enable “the external appearance to coincide with inner contents”, applying the excellent Chinese traditional culture elements into modern packaging design, is a problem worthy of study and discussion. In addition that the cultural meanings and form aesthetic feeling of blue-and-white elements are studied and analyzed, elements shall be constantly abstracted from the traditional natural objects, to perform re-creation in an analysis and reconstruction way. The composition principles and aesthetic forms of design are applied in packaging design, to enable the package to have national culture nature and times nature.

articleTitle: The matching relationship between product function design and children's ability
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The early education product design often market oriented, and ignored the features and requirements of users. The developers usually take purchaser's tendency and parent's desire as their guide of product design. So that, the function and content was not matching well with children's features. The design of function module, content module and interaction module were not fully considering children's characteristic. The characteristic include manipulate habits, psychological features and the interaction mode. Children's product design should combine the analysis of children's characteristic and the ability involved in the process of cognitive.

articleTitle: Creative idea generation of product modeling symbol
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The innovative value as well as the practical value are designers' critical thinking elements in the process of creative design. Throughout the process of creative ideas, original thinking is the core and foundation of the creative ideas, and it is also a capability in the process, which will bring new ideas, new visual style and even new ways of life to our sociaty. In this paper, the author explore the application value as well as the law of the modeling symbol in the process of product design through actual cases. At the same time, to create a new product, the designers can also follow no set form [ pattern ] while breaking through the limitation of old patterns and forms to create entirely new products.

articleTitle: Agile industrial design management based on Scrum
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: While the business of Yangtze River and Pearl River delta in China is booming, most OEM enterprises attempt to maintain or exploit market through rapid development or innovation in the form of customized design. With the design period is cut down greatly, in order to improve design quality on the current situation of industrial design in China, this paper proposes the method of agile industrial design, and builds the agility model with three major factors of dynamic team, lightweight process, and flexible methods. The method is adapted to the conceptual design process filled with uncertainty, especially in creativity and demand. Based on it, the paper introduces Scrum used in software development and analyzes its usability in the industrial design. Finally, agile industrial design management mode based on Scrum is constructed. It has solved the problem of rapid response ability in meeting the quality requirements of customers. This mode helps enterprises improve the scientific management in agile design environment.

articleTitle: The improved ergonomic design for XZM - 100 vibration grinning machine
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Based on the user center, combined the function, operation and physiological characteristics of human being, and focused on the scientific way of operation, redesigned the original XZM -100 Vibration Machine under the ergonomic system. XZM -100 Vibration Machine is operated by male and female. The first difficulty for operators is opening and closing the up-shell to complete the two actions of near and off the body within the two opposite positions of 90 degree Angle; the second is fastening the mortar. The main duty is to design the height of workbench to satisfy the operators to finish the TWO difficulties. According to GB/T14776, the design criterion for Vibration Machine is small size limit. Choose the design principle of the female, class II, standing work position, combine the structure of the grinding machine, the final height of workbench surface is 924 mm. And select female P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> percentile to restrict the highest workbench, the final height is 1069 mm, which is accord with ergonomic requirements. The design also improved the original operation method; reduced the difficulty to open and close the up-shell; and strengthen the mortar fastening method to simplify the function and structure of up-shell.

Author Keywords: the actions of opening and closing

articleTitle: Theory Bra design science and artistic expression
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This study analyzed the bra designed for WearerSelf-caused Comfort, physical beauty Degree and Bra itself in the form of beauty and give their own psychological feelings of cultural symbols. To use the human body Ergonomic related theories, Explore the design process in bra man and man and the environment, And “Formal” and “ ergonomics ” of the harmony and unity, so that bra design with every step of the human body as the basis. Also designed an artistic component and bra wearer to best match the actual performance of the state. Thus Discusses the design of science in the bra to be expressed in the form of art, designed to achieve a bra harmony of science and art.

articleTitle: Discussion on experience and product semantic communication
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In the new economic era, the focal point of the design has moved from rationality and practicability of product to the experience of the people. Experience is the mental effect consiousness caused by the interaction of people and product, the product becomes the tool for experience. In the process of using the product, the users get fantastic experience from deciphering the product semantic in three levels, visceral, behavior and reflective. The product is not the functional sum realized by them, their real value is to be able to satisfy the human's emotional experience needs, among these the most important one is to establish the users' self-image and social status.

articleTitle: New platform for collaborative business innovation system design in a virtual garment enterprise
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With computer technology, especially development of network technology, the virtual clothing business model has been given new features and powers under such organization. This article made a deep and systematic study on new model of virtual enterprises model and business innovation platform design combined with Web services technology on the basis of in-depth analysis of the characteristics and development trend of virtual enterprise. The collaborative commerce (CPC) can meet consumers' changing demands, accelerate the pace of business innovation, and realize enterprise innovation ability, adapting to the rapid technological development and economic globalization. In particular, a study on virtual collaborative commerce for SMEs management has great practical significance.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The combination of classical art and modern art—On the use of the elements of Suzhou gardens in the architecture by Ieoh Ming Pei
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Modelling of “metamorphoses” teaching research
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: “Metamorphoses” teaching will often encounter this phenomenon: one, the modelling of art does not understand, Second, in the form of the pattern of modernist school of western renovation, copy, blundering, deformation, superficial, no connotation, lack of observation and thinking. Currently there are even many of the distorted the absurdity aesthetics and creative behavior, the author thinks that people should also to be distorted aesthetic consciousness and irrational deformation is clear “exaggerated”. This paper from the fine arts modelling, the deformation of the types of deformation observation around the arts - thinking activity - the experience of teaching process, etc.

articleTitle: The impact on industrial design by the development of three-dimensional printing technology from a technical perspective
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The development of three-dimensional printing (3DP) technology will change the current pattern of manufacturing, business model, mode of production and our life style. We elaborate the trends and prospects of three-dimensional printing technology, analysis the impact and change for industry design. As well as responding to the change, industry designer should have new ideas, skills and new knowledge structure.

articleTitle: The design theory and methods of emotional concept product based on Kansei Engineering
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Up to now, the development of product design, in terms of purely rational function or external beauty, is no longer able to meet consumers' demand, and design sensibility and experience have become a new focus. With the rapid development of science and technology, there are abundant of material products in modern society, but at the same time, great changes have taken place in our material world and spiritual world. Under the premise that the basic needs have been satisfied, the needs of people have been shifted from material consumption to spiritual consumption, more and more people concern spiritual comfort and needs. In order to adapt to consumers' demand, product design pay more attention to emotional communications of products with people, to meet people's physical and psychological needs, so “Kansei” was referred to a new level, Kansei Engineering is a good way to translate sensibility into emotional element in product design. Based on the close association of perceptual science and cognitive sciences, from the perspective of cognitive psychology to position “Kansei” and making use of Kansei Engineering technology to translate “Kansei” into perceptual design elements to guide product design, we can put forward complete and feasible theory of emotional concept product model and the design methods combined with the design procedure.

articleTitle: An optimization of EGR control system for gasoline using fuzzy PID strategy
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In order to get a robust control for a gasoline engine EGR (exhaust gas recirculation) system, a fuzzy PID controller is developed and its performance is studied by comparing to the normal PID controller. First a GT-power model for the gasoline engine (with EGR) is constructed and verified. Based on this model, a PID control system and a fuzzy PID control system are developed. Then the step signal, the real time signal and the interference signal are used to test the response and the anti-interference performance of the two systems. The results reveal that the fuzzy PID control system works better than the PID control system in vibration prevention and anti-interference performance, which is more suitable for the gasoline engine.

articleTitle: A new approach for lofted B-spline surface approximation to scanned data
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of B-spline surface approximation to rows of points by B-spline surface lofting. Lofting is a well known surface create technique and has been used in CAD and CAGD. However, the traditional lofting approach tends to result in an astonishing number of control points in the process of merging the different knot vectors. This paper presents a new approach fixing this problem. The approach includes a novel process of creating a set of compact B-spline curves from the given points. The process is based on the binary search and the least-squares method, determining a set of local common knot vectors of most of rows of points, which meet the given conditions. Then, fully common knot vectors have been determined by the method of merging different knot vectors. The proposed approach is efficient in computation and can realize more efficient data reduction than previous approach without losing the shape of the lofted surface. Several experimental results demonstrate the usefulness and quality of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: The creation of the independence of visual communication design and visual effects
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Based upon detailed analysis of vision deliver designers' every creation stage, this article begins from vision deliver designers' non-digitalization and digitalization creation period, compares the completely independent period, cooperation creation period and leading creation period of individual creation, then gets a conclusion that creation independence is not a history of pure linear development, but a matter evolving and changing with time consecutively—the positive visual effect.

publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The research and practice of mechanical product identity system design theory
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This paper is the preliminary study of the mechanical product identity system design theory, based on which the author analyses and illustrates the use of this theory in practical product design and develop, and then demonstrates the operability and reliability of the theory.

articleTitle: Green research on the application of bamboo material on home appliances
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Bamboo has good ecological and cultural values. This paper aims at the re-designing of bamboo products, and talks about their developmental, creative, technological competitive features, which make company fully develop the value of bamboo at a possible low cost. At last, the paper draws to a conclusion that the research would be a trigger for the development of bamboo industry.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The inspiration to modern landscape design from “The Story of Peach Blossom Spring”
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: New exploration of modern furniture design based on ethical design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Furniture is an important component in people's daily life, with the development of the society and enhancement of the production process, the furniture design is confronted with some problems which shall be solved urgently. Through the analysis of the present situation of the furniture design in China, aiming at the furniture features, the paper attempts to seek the breakthrough point from the ethics angle, introduces the theory of design ethics into the furniture design, and requests the designers to undertake the moral duty in the design, and to make contribution to the balanced and coordinated development of human beings, environment and resources.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The development and design of the tourist souvenirs about brand “Clay Figure Zhang” in Tianjin
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A new role of designer's value through design consultation
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Design consultation, with the development of economic integration, globalization of industrial design, technology revolution in the world and social economy, has come into being and grown gradually, which has injected new energy for the innovation of products and the expansion of new markets. Meanwhile, designers' function and their means to create value have started to diversify, instead of the single one, designing products only. As far as the thesis is concerned, it introduces relevant literature first so that basic concept, classification and etc. of the present design consultation are given. Second, with the help of certain research in advance, it shows the growth and the trend of design consultation industry in Britain, Japan and South Korea, as well as designers' progress and the diversion of their function with economy development. Finally, the conclusion is given on the basis of the ambiguity of designers' function in product design consultation in present corporations. Besides, it points out what roles are likely to be played by designers, as the planner of the whole project, the maker of the strategy, the provider of the whole program, the guide of clients and the supplier of related database, while providing design consultation

articleTitle: Development pattern of industrial design in China
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to build up the development pattern of industrial design in China. Based on H. Alpay Er's six evaluation dimensions of the development pattern of industrial design in Newly Industrialized Countries, this paper put forward the four-phase development pattern of industrial design in China, which included “proto-design phase”, “introduction phase”, “adjustment phase”, and “take-off phase”. It puts forward that industrial design in China is facing the problem of how to transfer from cultural advocacy to institutional improvement and commercial practice. This pattern is useful for summarizing the 30-year development of industrial design in China.

articleTitle: The study on companionship scale of electronic pet
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In recent years, electronic pets have been accepted and popular gradually, related industries are booming, as one important area to the design industry. Because of some people cannot have a real pet for the limit of living environment, the electronic pet with part of real pet function, and don't need so much time to take caring, become the most popular game now. The electronic pets even not only just be a game, but emphasize the “company”. To establish the companionship is a design trend in electronic pet, but there isn't an appropriate measure tool for the electronic pet's companionship, also failed to provide designers a criterion for good and bad design. Lawson and Chesney (2007) proposed a scale which is only measured for the “real pets and people” part. The purpose of this study was modified the companionship scale of electronic pet of Lawson and Chesney (2007). The structures of the scale include three parts, the relations between “real pet and people”, “human companionship” and the “company features of electronic pet”. The scale subjects were designed by the professional experts. A total of 158 subjects joined the pretest, after item analysis, the new scale reliability Cronbach's α values is up to 0.95, with high reliability. The new scale could provide designers and users test the companionship of electronic pet, also can be used to analyze the companionship features of the existing electronic pets, so that designers and related industries can understand the current trends and the electronic pet shortcomings for improving the future design.

articleTitle: A study of the revitalization of Huashan creative & culture park in Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Culture & creative industries become a new power of economics of all countries thus it become hot issue recently. Most of the creative & culture parks were remodeled from old industrial heritage which full of culture & history. Those various contents of culture properties were the strong inspiration of cultural & creative industries.
