articleTitle: Study of industrial design practical education based on digital design experiments
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The establishment of innovative laboratory for new products development, which is based on the advanced instruments of digital design, was to provide a platform for student's practice. In the lab, the development projects of new products were bound with courses of industrial design major. The experiments result shows: studying how to use the advanced digital design instruments, the students could combine the theory and practice and find what he want to study. It was the laboratory that provided a new platform for connecting theory and practice and supported practical basis for industry, education and research.

articleTitle: A new reflection of “people-oriented” idea in the industrial design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This paper analyzed the positive sides and its limitations of the design by studying and rethinking the “people-oriented” idea, thus giving a more reasonable orientation to the “people-oriented” idea in the industrial design and then advocate that “people-oriented” idea must be built on the premise of the harmonious design. While we concern about people, we should also coordinate it with other relevant factors of design, so as to make design idea more rationalized. Meanwhile, a transition from “people-oriented” idea to “nature-oriented” idea is proposed without negating the former one.

articleTitle: Narrative analysis on camera language of U.S. and Japanese Animation
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Narrative is important to animation art because Animation is a film and television art form which disseminates information with pictures. The development of US-Japanese animation continues to expand affection to the world animation. Vivid picture effects and wonderful stories are accepted and loved by the majority of audience. Its success is inseparable from the flexible use of the lens. This paper attempts to investigate lens the important role of conveying narrative and expressing emotions of by Scene lens, depth of field, range of motion and other factors in the lens, which help to improve the quality of animation.

articleTitle: Economical analysis of packing-reuse design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: As a branch of design, the character packaging design mainly embodies in its economic attributes aspects. Just due to this, comprehensively understanding of its economical attribute not only helps deepen the understanding of nature of packaging design, but also grasp the packaging design process and application effect in social economy, which has great significance.

articleTitle: Research on design sketch teaching from the view of creative thinking
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Design sketch is at the core of the product design process. How to use design sketch to express design concepts and develop creative thinking, is the key point in design sketch teaching. Firstly, the definition, classification and function of design sketch are explained. Secondly, its importance in the product design process is analyzed. Then design sketch is compared with computer rendering. The uncertainty of design sketch is presented to reveal its ambiguity. Thirdly, the relationship between the ambiguity of design sketch and creative thinking is discussed. Finally, the teaching points of design sketch are proposed from two aspects of presentation techniques and training contents. Appropriate drawing tools and techniques should be chosen according to the characteristics of different stages of the design process and progressive training should be insisted on, so that design sketch can really serve as a primer for the successive courses of product design.

articleTitle: Research on product shape innovation design method with human-computer interaction through genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Based on the characteristics analysis of human and computer during the innovation process, a product shape innovation design method using genetic algorithm is proposed. In this method, the spline is applied to describe the contour of product, which defines the product form. Genetic algorithm is applied to optimize the points that constitute the spline, and then new shapes are created. The designer can select the satisfying product forms with the visual interface and actualize the product shape innovation design with human-computer interaction. Case study shows that the method can improve the efficiency of the creative design, and it is feasible and practical.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: On national culture inheritance in art design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Discussion on the application methods of the conversion of music into visual arts
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Many artists and designers have long been trying to convert music into visual arts. On the basis of the author's design practice, this article focuses on the analysis of the commonality of music and visual arts and divides from the aspect of synesthesia the methods adopted in the visualization of music into three categories: direct relevance, formal relevance and emotional relevance.

articleTitle: The personnel training and quality education of college interior design profession
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Compared to other profession in my college education, interior design profession education has a shorter development history. It has more or less problem in the students quality education, teachers strength, personnel training objective, personnel training modes, this text make a depth analysis to these problem, propose the new ideas and models of interior design profession personnel training, as propose the ideas of emphasized that students total quality training and personality development, and improve professional development of teachers and practice teaching experiences, and develop a education chain of “produce-learn-research”.

articleTitle: A Study on the brand strategy and awareness issues of Haechi, the symbol of Seoul
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: It is hard to market a character successfully without a manufactured identification of its design and content as well as a plan for future commercialization and circulation. The object of this study is to review the fundamental reasons for the low awareness of Haechi, the representative symbol of Seoul and to evaluate possible solutions to develop it as a character that people will love and support.

articleTitle: Fashion design conception based on female physical attractiveness
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The objective of the study was to provide a new perspective and entry point for creative fashion design. Through analyzing the historical evolution of female physical attractiveness, the interactive evolution of physical beauty and clothing popularity is summarized since ancient Greece to the 21st century. Three basic design techniques, involving bareness, reproduction and exaggeration, which are used in the expression of physical beauty, were put forward. The design process based on the ideal of female physical beauty was described, including decision making of the popular features of physical beauty, the choice of design techniques, and the application of principles and elements of design.

articleTitle: Application of CAE technology to internal combustion engine engineering
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Computer Aided Engineering technology is explained as well as the application to internal combustion engine is introduced in this paper. Related software which used for CAE technology in internal combustion engine is illustrated. Finally, the development trend of CAE technology in internal combustion engine is prospected.

articleTitle: A TRIZ-based process model for technology evolutionary potential forecast
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Product technology forecasting is an effective method to keep enterprises competitive advantage for a long term, and technology forecast tools of Theory of Inventive Problem Solving (TRIZ) can provide theoretical guides for technology forecasting. The technology evolution theory that belongs to technology forecast tools of TRIZ can be applied to identify evolutionary potential of a technical system and help decision-makers to make strategic decisions. In this article, The technology forecast tools of TRIZ were introduced, and a sequential process model for technology evolutionary potential forecast of product is then formed. Based on this process model, the technology evolutionary potential of hydraulic cylinder in China was forecasted.

articleTitle: Research on space form of early modern architecture in Zhenjiang
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Research of space form is an important part of the study in historic architecture. Based on the historical background, this paper makes the spatial form of early modern buildings in Zhenjiang as the object of the research and studies in space model and space organizational structure of the buildings, and further analyzes the influencing factors about its formation and development. At last, the paper summarizes the characteristics of early modern architectural space form in Zhenjiang.

articleTitle: Humanistic care in design of products for women
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: As economy develops, the role of women in modern society sees tremendous changes and women is becoming an essential market participant. With respect to such new changes, physiological and psychological difference between the sexes, as well as consumption psychology of various types of women, is analyzed in this paper. It states that the basic view, i.e., product designers should implement humanistic care for women from various aspects. In design of products, certain guidance by means of design psychology is to be provided for women so that women users can not only feel such humanistic care, but also get certain hint thus to promote self-actualization.

articleTitle: Talk about the protection of intellectual property rights of industrial design in China from the phenomenon of “shanzhai”
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The development of China's industrial design, must take the protection of intellectual property rights as strong backing, to get development by protection. But since 2008 fiercer phenomenon of“shanzhai” absolutely revealed the defects of China's intellectual property rights protection system of industrial design. The“shanzhai”phenomenon, superficially comes from low costs to high profits and consumer's excessive pursuit to cost performance, and essentially reflects Chinese manufacturing industry is in a transition period. On the mean time, it shows more brightly that the China's industrial design system of intellectual property protection is still very weak. Based on the current situation of China's industrial design, through three aspects of the state, enterprises, individuals respectively, take relevant measures such as perfecting the auditing system of intellectual property rights, intensifying infringement punishment and supervision, establishing specialized management department in enterprise, strengthening the awareness of intellectual property rights protection, to build a good social environment, so as to promote the enthusiasm of stylists and the development of China's industrial design.

articleTitle: Optimization design of segmented grinding wheel structure on super high-speed
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Be different from the structure design of traditional integrated super high-speed grinding wheel, In this paper, to control the radial displacement and reduce the equivalent stress of the super high-speed grinding wheel are set as the optimization objective in order to ensure the safety of grinding wheel. Models for the connection between inner micro-unit's displacement and stress of wheel base was established. By research the structural and mechanical characteristics of wheel base, strength check of the theoretical formula about variable cross-section wheel was also established. At last, super-high speed segment grinding wheel base type, wheel base material, wheel section number and wheel section thickness were optimized with finite element method. It proposed a reference rule for optimization design of segment grinding wheel.

articleTitle: Design calculating of ERF smart brake
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The characteristics of traditional vehicle brake were analyzed first. Based on ERF's ER effect, working mechanism and working model, a new vehicle brake which is the ERF smart vehicle brake has been designed successfully. Its structure and brake torque's size have also been analyzed, designed and calculated. The result showed that it's practical.

articleTitle: Research of iphone application UI design based on children cognition feature
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This research through the apperception, thinking, and memory of children cognition behavior respectively analyzes the features, combines the related knowledge of software interface design, gets the effective inspiration of iphone application design towards children, fully carry out the analysis of interaction manner and visual elements of hot procedure Fingerprint doodle, demonstrates the interface design direction effect produced by children cognition feature research.

articleTitle: Japanese food packaging in calligraphy
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Japan has a long history, and it is a superpower economic country in eastern. With the rapid development of economic globalization, the packaging design has developed quickly, and it just spends several years in finishing developing, which is supposed to last a century in eastern countries. Its success is worth for us to learning and reference. Janpanese characters have own glamorous. The paper will carry out this topic, and the essay expounds the analysis of Japanese calligraphy, the features of packing's orchestration. calligraphy characters is the creation of hommization design and nationality culture under speedy commodity economy development, and is the expectation of packaging designers to the whole packaging industry culture.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Considerations for talents in creative design for the culture creative industry development
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A research of Color Universal Design for hospital's Orientational sign
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Color Universal Design(CUD) is a design concept about the colors and communications and is mainly used to enrich the color of social environment in order to improve recognizabilities of the people who with various color-abilities which can recognize the information related to color easily, accurately and can communicate it accessibly. The Orientation sign in hospital provides spatial cognition and perspectives of overall space which easily make users feel confused, because of its functional complexity and special design. Accordingly, designers should pay attention to understand the demand of people with various color-abilities when doing their design work, and to achieve the goal of Color Universal Design, this work should be revised as repeatedly and continuously as possible.

articleTitle: The present situation and developing strategy of Suzhou's industrial design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: At first, this article makes use of factors influencing the development of industrial design to measure the development level of Suzhou's industrial design, and summarize the status of it based on statistical data analysis; then put forward the existing problems of it according to the status; finally come up with development strategies and suggestions.

articleTitle: The environmental protection concept in package design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The concept of environmental protection has become more realistic due to the environmental degradation. It used to be only a slogan, but now has become something that every one can see and touch. If package designers could apply the environmental protection concept into their designs, it'll cater to the needs of modern consumers and contribute to protecting the natural environment as well. The concept of environmental protection is at a spiritual level, but it will take various methods to make it real. This paper offers a detailed analysis on package design and how to apply the concept of into practical use. It also gives a balance between commercializing and environmental techniques and acts as a guide for package design on how to bring out the environmental protection concept and survive between the market and the environment.

articleTitle: Views under the feet —An analysis on the heels design of high-heeled shoes
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Since the appearance of high-heeled shoes, women have never ceased their pursuit of them. Both the shoe-makers in the past and the designers at present have never failed to realize the importance of heels while designing high-heeled shoes. Therefore, sufficient attention has always been paid to the innovation of heels design. The paper focuses on the avant-garde heels design of high-heeled shoes, leading readers to an art world of fashion.

articleTitle: Visualization of optimum design based on Genetic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The optimum design visualization is one of the focuses study at present, this paper will apply the visualization technology into the optimum design based on Genetic Algorithms(namely GAs). For the multi-variable objective function in the mathematics model, a new visualization approach for displaying N-dimensional function in 3-D Euclid Space is used in function graph. For the GAs population visualization, every individual in N-dimensional genetic space will be mapped to the polyline by using the Parallel Coordinate System(namely PCS). After optimum design, optimal results and middle data will be displayed in the standardized form. At last, a new visualization model for optimum design based on GAs is established in this paper.

articleTitle: Public fitness facilities design in the context of an aging society
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In the context of an aging society, the rational design of public fitness facilities has a positive meaning in improving health level and life quality of citizens, especially for the elderly group, and in building a harmonious society. The paper analyzes the current situation of outdoor public fitness facilities and proposes the principle and requirements of public fitness facilities design, in order to expect public fitness facilities to play its role to the greatest extent through scientific design, thus maximizing social benefits.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Look at the impact of folk visual language on modern design from Zhu Xian town's lunar New Year's painting
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on CAID teaching based on design process
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The computer technology bring an revolution of modern living, including industrial design. CAID (Computer Aided Industrial Design) software become an important tool in design, and CDIA teaching become a very important professional course in college of industrial design. It is urgent affairs to reform the CAID teaching method in order to service design better. This article discusses the present problems of CAID teaching, and puts forward a method of CAID teaching based on design process. Although it is not very mature, this method is a good experiment.

articleTitle: Achieving design innovation in the new century
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In the new century, computer and network technology greatly extends the original boundaries of design, enriches and expands the design thinking and methods of artistic production. To design means both the “endless possibilities” and “everywhere”: Users can access to information easier than before, the ways to appreciate design are becoming increasingly diversified. No matter how well designed, creating new designs means that human spirit and emotional view can't be overlooked. Providing objective, rational look at the design of the new century, three aspects are explored - from cultural dimension, rhetorical dimension and dimension of games. It provides the emerging contemporary design innovations a new reference.

articleTitle: The studies and explores visualization in the information of cultural heritage protection
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the accelerated globalization and the further development of city, the protection of the cultural heritage has already been the concept which could not be avoided in the new times. The cultural heritage was not killed in the wave of the modern science and technology quietly, instead has become the foundation of a national development. Protecting the cultural heritage, maintaining the inheritance of national culture, is not merely relates our economical development of country, but also the continuous power in civilized development. We are now facing the new topic that applying the new science and technology in the protection of cultural heritage, except for nurturing stronger sense of management and definitude of laws. I hope that stated clearly in this article that the technology of information visualization applying in the cultural heritage protection, and find a road of the solution for the protection of cultural heritage digitization.

articleTitle: Kinematics for a 2-DOF parallel manipulator
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Various planar motion curves are commonly seen in industrial operations. The particular requirements are not only imposed on the displacements (straight line, circle, curve) but also on the dynamics (velocity, acceleration). A novel planar parallel mechanism, whose actuation point is located between two parallel guide rails, is presented in this paper. This simple but practical mechanism is capable of realizing a large workspace. The direct and inverse kinematical solutions are given. The simulation demonstrates that all kinds of straight lines and circles can be realized by the end actuator of the mechanism; the corresponding motion disciplines and characteristics driven by the two sliders are analyzed. This paper lays the foundation for the real-time control and industrial application of the 2-DOF parallel manipulator.

articleTitle: Simulation to control the car interior noise in high frequency using SEA method
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The SEA simulation method to reduce car interior noise in high frequency is introduced by the properties modification of door glass. An SEA (Statistical Energy Analysis) model of a domestic car was built. The inputs of interior noise were got by the roads testing and other simulations. The accuracy of this model was validated by the comparison results of testing and software. The following simulation expresses that the car interior noise implemented laminated door glass is better than the one using tempered door glass in high frequency, and the thicker glass is not useful obviously for reducing high frequency noise. If the total thickness and PVB (polyvinyl butyral) film are same and only modify the thickness of the outer glass and inner glass, the sound pressure level of car interior noise will be affected not so much. Compared to the application of tempered door glass, the application of laminated door glass can reduce the car interior noise efficiently in high frequency. And the research in this paper can be used to guide the car interior noise control using nonmetal materials in high frequency.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A study on the application of Chinese traditional art in fashion ornaments design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Some thoughts on Computer Aided Design in the graphic composition teaching
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: CAD (Computer Aided Design) not only brings convenience to the creation but also puts forward the new challenge to the teaching when it is applied to the course of graphic composition. The emergency of CAD provide a brand new way of expression of graphic composition, but also raise the concerning to tradition hand painted design. Can we only enjoy the convenience brought by CAD in the course? In fact, it is not true. CAD also provides fun of painting, chance of trace and brand new ways of thinking and expression for us as hand painting does. In this paper, based on the application of computer aided design on the necessity and superiority in the course of graphic composition, stressed the need to face CAD the existence value. Through the reasonable use of computer hardware and software, computer aided design in graphic composition plays its unique design tools.

articleTitle: New media art aesthetics in the context of traditional Chinese arts
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: New media art created a comprehensive aesthetic experience, interactive process of aesthetics, the virtual nature of the aesthetic situation, which have relevance to traditional Chinese aesthetic concepts of “unity between man and nature” and “all compassionate concept”k it is necessary to learn and develop the aesthetics of traditional Chinese arts to adapt to the aesthetic orientation of new media art and artistic expression, and then new media art in China will continue to highlight features of the times and national identity.

articleTitle: Research on functional innovation of intelligent wheelchair based on internet survey
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: As one of the mobile robots, intelligent wheelchair is used to assist the daily life of the old people and the handicapped. Thanks to be short of systematical design and a method and tool of earlier stage analysis, there are more control innovation than functional innovation about intelligent wheelchair in market. This study explodes the research situation and design feature, and improve the KISS system (a network-based Kansei image survey system) to experiment on wheelchair's functional orientation of earlier stage design. According to the analysis of experimental data, the study proves the feasibility of the system and forecasts the development tendency of intelligent wheelchair's functional innovation.

articleTitle: Geodesic Cutting and Grinding curve
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: An algorithm to compute a geodesic path over an arbitrary topological mesh was presented. Given two points over an arbitrary topological mesh, an initial approximation of discrete geodesic between two points is obtained by using Fast Marching Method. Initial approximation is iteratively corrected by getting the intersection point of two space straight lines. Thus a discrete geodesic between two points is obtained. The method avoids classing mesh vertex and computing equation of a plane where mesh vertex is so that it is practicable for computing a discrete geodesic over an arbitrary topological mesh. Furthermore, an algorithm of geodesic Cutting and Grinding curve is given over an arbitrary topological mesh. Geodesic free curves over arbitrary topological mesh were constructed by using the algorithm, such as geodesic B-spline curve of degree two. Some important properties were proved for geodesic Cutting and Grinding curve, such as convex hull, local adjustment and convexity preserving properties. Under Visual C++6.0, some examples of geodesic curves on convex and concave triangulated surface, geodesic curves on quadrangular subdivided surface and geodesic B-spline curve of degree two on triangulated arbitrary topological surface were given by OpenGL. Examples show that two algorithms are correct, stable, fast, easy in implementation. There is a good effect of simulation for all examples.

articleTitle: Based on AtriosCAD analysis of development and design of collapsible fast-food boxes
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the high-speed development of modernization, the pace of life is also accelerating. Catering to the development of modernization, a lot of convenient fast food is also becoming increasingly popular among the consumers. But the convenient instant food, especially instant noodles which require “secondary processing” ,need large package volume, which takes a lot of room in the shelves and is often not conducive to carrying and transporting. Therefore, this topic primarily aims at design thing a series of new green collapsible paper fast-food boxes, to solve problems such as the space-saving, transportation stacking, being portable and so on, in the meanwhile meeting the needs of sustainable development. The design of collapsible fast-food boxes is based on AtriosCAD. And the structure adopts the most commonly used packaging carton folding method, so the packaging form is simple and processing cost is low. This design uses folding structure and the volume when open is as large as when it is on transportation, which makes it easy to be transported and carried, greatly reducing logistics costs; this structure uses the novel folding method, which enables consumers to use the box simply and conveniently.

articleTitle: Solution for modelling and plumbic block locating in sinking artificial fish-simulated bait
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The effect of artificial fish-simulated bait in sea fishing is obvious. However, the manufacture of artificial fish-simulated bait still does not implement automation design. According to the need of customers, the request of artificial fish-simulated bait's external shape is special to make the irregular shape of artificial fish-simulated bait. In order to design the shape of artificial fish-simulated bait fast and intuitively for customers, this paper uses computer software design technology to build the mathematical model of artificial fish-simulated bait's, by changing the parameters of model to get artificial fish-simulated bait which has different kinds of shape to supply the demand of customers, giving intuitive design effect for customers visually. Artificial fish-simulated bait is divided into two types, One is sinking type, the other is floating type. The first one needs plumbic block to be filled, but the second one does not need. By analyzing the force of sinking artificial fish-simulated bait in seawater, we can get parameters which can influence sinking of artificial fish-simulated bait, then calculate these parameters by using physical and mathematical methods to gain the locating algorithm of the plumbic block.

articleTitle: Positioning and functional study of murals in high-speed rail VIP lounge
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The approach of Chinese high-speed rail era provides a wide platform for the development of modern murals. As the first window to meet domestic and foreign guests, the murals in high-speed rail VIP lounge are a comprehensive display of the local regional characteristics and features in the railway station. Murals are more than material space form that appears in VIP lounge, her charm and success in VIP lounge lie in the fact whether she can build an artistic form matching the regional culture and spirits and whether she can organically converse and positively interact with the aesthetic needs of her spectators. All of these become new challenges that mural creation must face. Based on the association between the high-speed rail VIP lounge and mural art, this paper conducts a research into the positioning and function of murals in high-speed rail VIP lounge with the basic characteristics of the mural art as starting point and in combination with the design case of the murals in the VIP lounge of Chengdu East railway station.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Application of Zen Style in Modern Fashion Design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The product development strategies of Longquan sword based on digitalized innovative technology
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Combining with the practice of design, the thesis is about to solving problems emerging in the creative development of Longquan sword, an Intangible Cultural Heritage. It's assumed to utilize digitalized innovative technology to assemble the resource of sword design, promote the application of new materials or new techniques, and then lead to the large batch production with high additional values. Finally the further development of Lonquan sword industry will be realized.

articleTitle: Research on modern security product design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the rapid development of China's economy, the property of the people is increased, and there appear a series of social contradictions; the guarantee of personal safety and security of the social assets have become the focus of various walks of life. As the key in the guideline of the combination of “human prevention, technology prevention and property prevention” determined in China, the security products do not arouse the attention of industrial designers. The theory and practice research is seriously lack in China. This paper examines the development trends of the security product design from the industrial design perspective, on the basis of research analysis, puts forward the proposal that the industrial designers shall participate in the integrated development and design of security products, and summarizes the elements and principles of the integrated development and design of security products.

articleTitle: Virtual measuring system of the geometric error based on LabView
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The paper constructs a virtual detection system of geometrical errors with powerful virtual instrument LabView software, and realizes the simulation tests of the parts' form error, direction error, position error and run-out error. The system could test the data by different data processing methods, and get the reports of the tested data and error results.

articleTitle: Research on bionics design of sedan contour
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The bionic design is an important method in automobile design field. For sedans have occupied main part of the car market, car companies have changed their focus on sedans as their production management. In contour design, nearly all parts of a sedan like vehicle sculpt, the front face, the tail, and lamps can be used in approach of bionic design, which may give refresh feelings to people.

articleTitle: Design of the outdoor furniture on pedestrian shopping street
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The outdoor furniture is not only an important part of the shopping area but also a necessary part of the city environment. This paper analyses the purpose and the usefulness of outdoor furniture on pedestrian shopping street. This paper will explain how to design outdoor furniture and give six factors to consider, such as humanization, ecology, etc..

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Interaction study on development of cultural creative industry and intangible cultural heritage in Zhejiang Province—A case study of Tonglu paper-cut
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Minimum-contrast dominate visual search on complex-color background
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: As we know, the visual attention is greatly influenced by color salience although there are many other important factors such as orientation and spatial frequency. In this study, serial experiments of target search on complex background have been performed. As a result, all experiment results indicate that the response time (RT) is mainly dominated by the minimum-contrast rather than the mean-contrast or the maximum-contrast. This paper suggests that the target salience ought to be measured by the minimum-contrast between target and background in visual search based on color, and propose a salience model based on the minimum-contrast.

articleTitle: The development of arts education in the context of new media art
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The features of new media art are cross-disciplinary, interaction, media-dependence and grass-roots. We can predict the development of arts education and curriculum reform from these features: open to the public and open curriculum, the confluence of technology and art, focus on practicalness and innovativeness which are four principles of futural arts education development.

articleTitle: Research of maya high-level animation on arm binding skill
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The role binds to settle to have a prominent function in the role animation creation process, is also a role animation research at the same time one is a little bit hot in the middle of the realm and crux. Is special to bind to settle to the cartoon role, various project is more multifarious, but aim only have a, that be how make animation teacher more simple regulate a various desirable action but don't lose a role personality characteristic. This text bound to certainly commence from the arm and flew to through chart and data way to in details analyze various bind to settle medium meet of problem, and tally up a set of way of thinking with should to various action need.

articleTitle: Folding art conforms to small spatial furniture design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Small spatial furniture design is one of the current relevant investigative subjects. Because of its unique merit, folding art which function perfectly combines with form conforms to the small spatial furniture design in aspects of function, emotion and shape and so on. Using the character of folding art to the small spatial furniture design would manifest the essence of industrial design — humanist.

articleTitle: Based on environment behavior theory of space design of housing fair
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: On the basis of the introduction to the study of environment behavior, the paper researches the space composition design in the exhibition design; it introduces the orientation of design suitable for the space of Housing Fair through analyzing the designer's directed thinking during design, the principle and the rules in the designed work, in order to provide the authentic theory for the design; and according to the designers and the audiences' feelings, it gets their opinions and suggestions on the design, so as to find a complete and personalized space design idea for Housing Fair.

articleTitle: One metaphorical design of mobile terminal interface
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This paper is studying on the background that when remote controlling intelligent vehicles, people can use multi-touch interaction to assist voice interaction to solve the problems that by using voice interaction alone cannot be solved. And this work is trying to design a metaphorical interface to make the interaction between users and interfaces more natural and fluent.

articleTitle: Research on integral design and innovation of street furniture in Hangzhou
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The design of street furniture has been attached great significance by society and government due to great impetus brought by urban construction process. In this paper a comprehensive investigation is conducted on the development of street furniture in Hangzhou and street furniture and design practices are studied deeply, on the basis of which an integrated design perspective on the construction of street furniture with Hangzhou characteristics is put forth with a view to play drawing lessons to similar issues encountered in the development of urban construction.

articleTitle: The drawing ability required in interior design : Study from the viewpoint of interior design employees
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The purpose of this study is to discuss the drawing ability required in interior design, and the fact that the cultivation of interior designers rely on school education and career experience. Therefore, drawing ability required in interior design is further explored and discussed from school courses and professional ability in the industry. The questionnaire survey method is applied on employees to explore the opnion ofemployees. In this study, the following is perceived: 1. regarding the cultivation of interior design drawing abilities, there is a difference between school education and the needs of the industry; the required drawing credits take up an average of 12% of the graduation credits; there are drawing courses in every school, including drawing, presentation, working drawing, and computer aided drawing. 2. Interior design professionals believe: (1) the drawing integrity used in the current industry is insufficient, and the completion of drawings are significantly related to working hours and quality, (2) the ability to understand drawings is considered as one of the most important professional abilities, (3) due to the common use of computers today, the industry places relatively low importance on hand drawing abilities, (4) the most needed drawing abilities for the industry are “concept of space” and “working drawings”, and (5) the most suitable 2D computer aided software for the interior design industry is AutoCAD, and the most suitable 3D software are 3DSmax, SketchUp and AutoCAD 3D, respectively.

articleTitle: An analysis of cultural factors in high-speed train design—Taking Acela Express high-speed train as an example
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The production of high-speed train in China is technology-oriented, rather than design-oriented, so the analysis and research of high-speed train related to design and cultural factors is very scarce. In this article, the author took Acela Express high-speed train as an example, and analyzed the influence of multi-cultural factors in high-speed train design. The analysis of the article carried out from two aspects: one is the users' cultural backgrounds of the design, which refers to countries or regions in which the train are running; the other is the providers' culture of the design, including high-speed train operators and designers. Through a detailed interpretation and analysis of the impact of cultural factors on Acela Express design, the author attempts to provide a useful reference to China's high-speed train design.

articleTitle: Product Identity based waterpipe fittings product development
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Product Identity(PI) has been recognized and applied commonly in many fields. Pipeline industry faces vicious competition as a result of low entry barrier and relatively simple manufacturing technology. This paper provides a PI based water pipe fittings product development solution. The design has been adopted by ZHEJIANG ZHUJI NANXIN PIPELINE,and the trial-manufacture gains a good market acceptance and success.

articleTitle: Evaluation on Pro-Engineer & manufacturing module in industrial design modeling process
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This report gives a general evaluation on Pro-Engineer, the parametric 3D software, for its usages in industrial design fields, and lists the brief process to simulate machining a digital 3D model with manufacturing module and focuses on optimization of setting the machining tools and working parameters in different steps to promote the machining efficiency and quality for actual manufacture or rapid prototyping in later stages.

articleTitle: Fatigue life analysis of a new semi-trailer frame based on FEA method
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In allusion to the frame of a certain semi-trailer, through adopting ANSYS software, its stress response, modal response and random vibration response were calculated with FEA method under various load cases. The finite element fatigue analysis was carried out in the form of load spectrum, as well as fatigue life and the stress strain variation laws of the vehicle frame under dynamic loads have been obtained, which provide the valuable reference for the vehicle frame structure improvement and optimization. The analysis method adopted in this paper have significance to shorten product design cycle, save cost of testing and producing, reduce the development cost and guarantee the security, stability and reliability of the product.

articleTitle: About model link in Design Process
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This article is a redefinition for the meaning of Design Process. When designers add model link in design process, they reread and reknow the design elements before the new idea is born. They focus on the relations among all the design elements and care about the scales in the whole space. They forget what the original rules and what they are asked to be and they are just fascinated by the feeling of the “people” in the model there. They try to figure out what the “people” want there and how to adjust the design elements to satisfy the “people's” requirements there. So if we change design process a little, we may find a new way to realize our design dream in brain. Also some excellent examples are given here to support the idea and some new design projects are shown here as well.

articleTitle: Annatto furniture design works of college students in some problems
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Based on college students annatto furniture design contest works as a starting point, the traditional annatto furniture culture essence in college of design, and pointed out the advantages and disadvantages of last, according to the present situation of annatto furniture industry, puts forward several opinions overall.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research about application layers of traditional cultures on product design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research of animated short film fine style—Example of opera theme animation “farewell my concubine”
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: As the animated short film form of the particularity, needs to create the fine style of more artistic charm. Based on the animated short film analysis of the unique fine style, example of opera theme of animation short film “farewell my concubine”, from the fine style show, opera theme select, reference and use elements of opera,consider of innovation development the fine style should be combination Chinese opera arts in todays, explore new forms of fine art style, inheritance and development of traditional Chinese culture.

articleTitle: Application of dynamic logos in modern visual system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In order to adapt to the demand of continuous development of the times, logos in modern visual system design is no longer the expression form in a single static model, and shall adapt to the modern, new, changing digital visual system environment. The development of logo design shall coincide with the times. Serialized dynamic logos adapt to the diverse and dynamic change, and the science and technology revolution and the development of the media such as Internet also provide a solid stage for the appearance of the new logo form.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The study on the improvement method of culture product design to value of national brand at the National Museum of Korea
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Empirical study of urban youth consumer groups for sportswear brands
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Because the sports apparel brand market competition becomes more intense and youth consumers on apparel demand continues to increase, young consumer groups gradually become key targets that enterprises cultivate brand loyalty for market segments. This paper surveyed young people based in Hangzhou about the group sports apparel brand consumer motivation, brand awareness, brand repeat purchase rate, favorite brand ambassador and the channels that youth consumers get to know the sportswear brands. Such a deep level approach to analysis drew a conclusion and provided references and helps for the sports apparel company product positioning, product development and marketing strategies.

articleTitle: Exploration of public facilities design in aging society
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the aging population increasing, the public facilities design has aroused more concern and research. The paper attempts to link with the backdrop of aging society to analyze the problems in existing public facilities design. It sets up the Design Concept “Centered on the Elderly, Balanced the General”; proposes the design principles of universality, security and easy of use; analyzes the color selection of public facilities design by a sample survey of old people and makes suggestions for public facilities design elements such as materials and new technologies, etc.

articleTitle: The domestic of tourism situation analysis and design methods
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Smokeless industry, tourism has become China's attention, and industry, with the development of The Times, to find city art and souvenirs. People should pay attention to the topic. Based on the tourist souvenirs Qinhuangdao as the research object, analyses the existing problems of the tourist souvenirs to solve the existing problems, and puts forward the solutions, in hopes of Qinhuangdao's tourism souvenir design can be used for reference.

articleTitle: Design of a chain-type self-reconfigurable robots
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: As for military reconnaissance, disaster relief applications such as stairs, stair type of obstacle, the paper propose the use of chain -type self-reconfigurable robots, overally plan the function modules of the robot, finish the design and making of the robot's mechanical system and control system and the corresponding performance testing. The test results show that the design is scientific and reasonable and meet the application requirements. Innovation in this article include: enhancing the use of harmonic reducer, realizing a large reduction ratio and high output torque in a smaller space; using a number of highly integrated controller chip in the control system's functional modules to separate the task between scheduling and implementation. Embeding microcontroller is mainly responsible for scheduling management, and specific implementation can be finished by the lower control chip. This can greatly reduce the burden on microcontroller, let the microcontroller to have more time to respond and deal with real-time event, and so that the embeding control system has good performance of real-time, and it is helpful to achieving the intelligent control of the self-reconfigurable robots team.

articleTitle: Analysis and design of the teaching affairs management information system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: It is very important to advance the teaching and management level by using the modern Internet technology. Whether the teaching affairs management information system successful or not is due to the potential of the system could be exploited to maximum. Now we take the construction of the teaching affairs management information system of ZUST as an example to analysis and design the management idea and method. And we will state the system design idea and the reasons for choosing hardware and software which support the system.

articleTitle: Construction of virtual simulation system for interactive display platform Of traditional Chinese culture: A discussion of its design, characteristics and problems
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This paper discusses the application of virtual reality display of Chinese painting and calligraphy, acupuncture, Taiji Taiji pushing handsing hands and other Chinese cultural elements. Using virtual reality technology can not only demonstrate the movement details of Chinese painting and calligraphy, acupuncture, and Taiji exercises, but also involve the visitors better, allow them to consciously imitate the processes, and to experience and understand the subtlety of Chinese culture. Prior to this, the foreign and domestic audiences have mostly been exposed to Chinese culture in the visual forms. Even though there were some all-round displays, they can not possibly come to know the subtle approaches or the very fine correspondence between heart/mind and actions of the artists, performers and healers. This paper presents discussion and design of the virtual simulation system for interactive display platform of traditional Chinese culture that can be applied to exhibition halls and for education purposes.

articleTitle: Universal design for interactive digital television in China
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Universal design refers to a broad-spectrum solution to design of products or services to be usable by everyone, regardless of age, ability or circumstance. In this article, we will research the actual situation of population structure and interactive digital television development in China, and analyze the difference of the using environment between the iTV and the tradition television. According to the basic principle of universal design and the confliction solving method, we will put forward a new universal design principle of interactive digital television to satisfy the need of intelligent and usable household appliance in the future.

articleTitle: The study on the evolution and variation of product
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Designers begin to pay close attention to rules of product development. This paper made a detailed study on reasons for evolution and variation of product, and defined phenomena of product evolution and variation. It also gives some reasonable new trends of product evolution and variation. The research attempts to provide a new thinking of product design.

articleTitle: Based on SimulationXpress analysis on bending strength of the plastic honeycomb board
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This paper studies the bending deformation of plastic honeycomb panels, with analysis of the plastic honeycomb panel with the basic structure and some of the features and application fields and future. This Article obtained the relationship between honeycomb apertures and bending strength by SimulationXpress computer simulation MOR experiments, draws a continuous aperture - strain curve, Analysis of the pore size of honeycomb panels - strain curve characteristics. By analyzing the bending deformation of cellular mechanical properties of plate and found the plastic deformation of honeycomb plate bending model of an ideal honeycomb aperture, which for plastic honeycomb panels in furniture and other applications, such as the construction sector has an important significance. Honeycomb plate by drawing a continuous curve of the bending deformation, which is the choice of plastic honeycomb panel bending strength and pore structure within the cellular significance in the design. This is the field of plastic honeycomb panels in furniture and other engineering applications have some reference and guidance.

articleTitle: The 3D simulation of mechanic arm based on IK system
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In view of the motion process simulation and path planning for mechanic arm, this paper presents a visualized simulation method based on inverse kinematics. Based on Inverse kinematics of multi-joint mechanic arm and 3D simulation model technology, the whole motion process simulation has been solved, which can provide reference standards for the mechanic arm selection and the motion planning in automatic sorting system design.

articleTitle: Research on integrative characteristic of interior and exterior traditional residential environment in south of Yangtze River
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the interaction of the Confucianism, social culture and lifestyle, residential environment in south of Yangtze River shows up integrative characteristic of interior and exterior from three aspects doing analysis and research which are layout of architecture, decoration interior and exterior, and construction image of space.

articleTitle: The application and research of product image quantitative analysis in mobile design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The product is the foundation and prerequisite of survival and development of the enterprise. The product image is the formation of the character of a unified image in the product design, development, research and development, distribution and use, is the uniform results of the image quality of the product internal and External visual image .In Nowadays' mobile product homogenization, The quality of the product image will directly affect the mobile phone manufacturers and whether can achieve good social and economic benefits. This article proposed the three-tier meaning of the product image from the concept of product integrity, described the product image design factors and apply the quantitative analysis of product image to measure the value of the mobile product image. The article proposed specific ideas and methods of product image design for building a more perfect image of mobile products to provide a theoretical basis for further study based on Product image analysis of mobile phone specific case, from the sample selected, the selection of adjective phrases product image, questionnaire design, research and analysis to analyze in detail.

articleTitle: A study on the factors of automobile styling with preferences of young people in China
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Things have been able to become a carrier of social meaning, identity and status is due to their structure such as form, material, color, brand, space order and so on. Chinese automotive industry and automotive consumers market has been developed into the world's largest automobile consumer market rapidly. The study of design elements on Chinese consumers' preferences is necessary for the automotive design. In this paper, we conducted questionnaires and collected model samples of consumers' preferences using Frequencies analyze and Crosstabs analyze methods. We suggested the specific elements in the automotive design preferences target on China young generation and analyze the different preferences between female and male.

articleTitle: The integer bath cabinet function design study on modern life style
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Great changes in modern life style, use behavior and family model make severe request for functional creative design of the integer bath cabinet. This article starts from the life style and use behavior of family users, discusses the innovation and shortage in functions of family integer bath cabinet made up of light before mirror, mirror, basin and bath cabinet, so it puts up with the design principles of product's functional innovation in order to satisfy the requirements of mainstream family users with modern life style.

articleTitle: The vocal music education in institutions of higher learning under the background of multimedia technology
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In today's society, the multimedia technology has been widely applied in various fields. Yet, it has been effectively promoted and emphasized in the vocal music education in institutions of higher learning. The paper starts from the analysis of the long-existing questions in vocal music education in institutions of higher learning, and provides some new thoughts to solve the problems by introducing the application of multimedia technology related software programs and the mode in institutions of higher learning, to promote teaching reform and enrich the teaching means.

Author Keywords: vocal music education in institutions of higher learning

articleTitle: Green design course multi-dimension goals setting and achieving
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The environmental issue has become a very important and pressing issue today. Almost everyone in the discussion of related issues such as: clean energy, emissions standards, green materials, low-carbon life, and so on. But few people talk about education, especially design education for the significance of ecological sustainable development. This paper tries to use four instances to elaborate the green design teaching and it how to achieve its multiple objectives in specific ways.

articleTitle: Low carbon exhibition—2010 Shanghai world expo exploration
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
