articleTitle: MEMS-based digital TV interaction innovation research
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Digital TV will become a family entertainment center in the future. There are several problems of the traditional way to interact with remote control. MEMS technology can be applied to revolutionize human-computer interaction of digital TV, bring user more unique experience and prompt greatly the development of digital TV and set top box industry.

articleTitle: Multi-agent based approach to collaborative shopping
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: With the rapid expansion of the Internet, the implementation of agent technology in electronic commerce (e-commerce) becomes very popular, which provides a promising field for the approach of agent and Artificial Intelligence technology. In this paper, we describe a multi-agent intelligent shopping assistant in collaborative shopping, and present the agent-based model for intelligent shopping assistant. The user interacts with the agent by means of a text dialog, and the input texts are translated into agent communication language through XML.

articleTitle: Reflection on attributes of color design analysis on development of Chinese Color Design Education
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Color design developed into a specialty in Europe at the end of 1960s and beginning of 1970s. Chinese Color Design Education originated at the beginning of 21<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">st</sup> century. As a newly emerging specialty deriving from arts design school, it is born to meet the needs of social development. Only by understanding the reason of its rising, the connotation of color design and the attributes of color design can we conduct effective positioning and thinking on the development of color design education.

articleTitle: A research in the integration degree between product image and corporate brand image
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Many domestic shaver enterprises do not establish clear corporate image in their consumers. In this paper, it takes an electric shaver corporation, Flyco, as an example, to explore the difference between its product image and the competitors' product image. The integration degree between product image and corporate brand image is analyzed through semantic differential method. Some suggestions are given for defining and improving the corporate brand image.

articleTitle: The differentiation way of integrated ceiling products
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Integrated ceiling industry faces product duplicating and homogenization competition. JINDING brand must make its differentiation way if it intends to gain considerable development and success. It points out that JINDING brand can make its product way on classical or archaized style and introduces a new enterprise idea of “Pioneer of Archaized Ceiling ”. By the way of searching segment market and serving high and medium home decorating, it matchs classical style product image with luxury and comfortable decorating style. In this way, point to area, promote enterprise brand ungrading. They should make use of external excellent design resources and integrate internal design power, go in for product development, use market methods like releasing through large expo in Beijing, Shanghai and Guangzhou and make more ceiling distributors know the advantages and potentials of JINDING company.

articleTitle: Limited animation: History and artistic techniques
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This paper looks back upon the important periods in the history of limited animation, as well as figures and animation movies during those periods. On the basis of that, this paper makes initial study about the artistic techniques of limited animation, and puts forward two levels with five common techniques in the motion design when making a limited animation movie. In addition, this paper compares limited animation with full animation, especially in the methods of art design as well as storyboard design.

articleTitle: The application of scale coefficient of evaluation in subjective assessment
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: By analyzing the problems of the subjective evaluation, put forward that the appraisal scale coefficient's concept and the determination method, then the establishment mathematical model for quantitative analysis, carries on the fair evaluation to the sample. While also given the appraisal to the different evaluators evaluation of the level, the fair degree evaluation criteria. In the judgment process, suppresses to intend the unfair phenomenon the occurrence, carries on the accurate appraisal objectively to the sample.

articleTitle: Conference information system based on Pervasive Computing
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Pervasive Computing is a new emerging computing model. In Pervasive Computing environment, users can get services anytime and anywhere. Conference Information System faces a variety of needs of users, and needs to provide ubiquitous and dynamic services, users can access data via mobile devices. In this paper, the conference information system based on Pervasive Computing is proposed. This system is used in ubiquitous networks, providing users with real-time and dynamic query. Users can query the progress of conference and the current state of papers anytime and anywhere, in addition, through this platform, they can use such universal services as local papers submission and online evaluation review, finally set up a comprehensive Pervasive Environment for conferences. This system is running on the mobile client (mobile phone) and the web server. In the mobile client, we use J2ME and KXML2, while in the web server we adopt SSH lightweight framework, using JSP, JDBC and XML.

articleTitle: Study on reforger and biology mechanics of individual femur
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: The artificial prosthesises currently used are only different in the femoral head size, neck length and stem thickness, but there is not any individualized prosthesis. At present, prosthesis looseness is the main problem of artificial femoral replacement, and individual matching level of joints is the bottleneck of restricting prosthesis replacement surgery. If we can design and produce corresponding individual artificial joints according to the patient's bone shape and bio-mechanical characteristics, there will be a significant impact on human health and medical treatment. In this paper, I complete the reconstruction process of the CT three-dimensional finite element model of femur, with the help of powerful image processing functions of medical imaging system MIMICS. I load force with the experimental data provided by the VIMS laboratory, analyze the biomechanical properties of femur and investigate the influence of anteversion angle parameter on mechanical properties by FEM, The results indicated that the stress pattern of femur implanted was similar to the one of intact femur.

articleTitle: Elastic information matching technology and its application in electronic recruitment
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In the employment services field, E-employment based on intelligent matching algorithm is being more and more attention. And the key points lie in elastic information matching and setting the weight of demand index. In the basis of domain ontology, this paper analyzes the electronic employment process, and adopts numerical matching and skill matching algorithm to solve the problem of elastic information matching and AHP to solve the weight setting problem, and last a recruitment progress of “graphic designer” is presented as an example to prove the feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: Design concept of the new international teaching buildings in modern universities
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Most of the teaching buildings in early universities used to focus on good looks, simple functions and the functional divisions. This design mode has brought about many problems while widely used, such as insufficient traffic within the building, disordered architectural forms and the lack of communication between the building designer and the users. This paper comes up with the idea of a new design concept of the international teaching buildings in modern universities, which creates a public space for socializing and brings out the integration of teaching and research. The design, which is more people-friendly, will present people with the integration of cultures, thus making the teaching building a complex with intensive and international elements.

articleTitle: Discussion on modeling design and implement of ATV
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Discussion on three important steps in modeling design and implement of ATV: concept design, clay model design and surface design. Software imageware and Pro/Engineer is used to achieve eliminating noise points acquisition from physical model, reconstruction CAD digital model in computer. Introduce an entire procedure of product prototype design which is a method application in technology of reverse engineering.

articleTitle: The probe of the possibility of establishing native toy brands
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In China, 30% of the total population is the children. According to the statistics of the citizenry, 40% of the expenditure of the Chinese family is for the children, and the cost of toys is big part of it. Now in Chinese markets, there is almost no famous Chinese brand of toys, but the copies of western designs or western brands. The thesis is to discuss the possibility of founding Chinese famous brands of toys based on the characters of business culture of brands, the psychic factors of children, the sources of native culture and the effect of foreign products of toys.

articleTitle: On harmonious thought in Taoist martial arts and the design of tourism souvenirs
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: By analyzing the construction of harmonious society and studying Chinese Taoist martial arts, it is concluded that learning and understanding Taoist martial arts plays an important part in understanding harmonious society. The article not only shows the importance of understanding harmonious society by knowing about Taoist martial arts, but also introduces the achievement of learning Taoist martial arts and understanding harmonious society to the design of tourism souvenirs. Meanwhile, the article points outs that the construction of harmonious society and the design of tourism souvenirs have major significance for the development of tourism economy.

articleTitle: Research on countermeasures of Chinese tourist commodities development
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: In China, various problems such as weak quality consciousness, lack of local feature and culture connotation, lack of creativity and low taste, a few levels and serious disjunction among each part of Tourism Industry, exist in the course of developing tourist commodities. As a result, to satisfy the need of the consume market, develop the cultural tourism resources and enrich the cultural potentials of the tourism products are the key projects which should be solved at present. It is also an important task to accelerate the development of tourism. So, this paper suggests that the development of tourist commodities should be premised on the government's guidance, directed by sustainable development ideas, supported by resources, having connotation of culture, based on features, directed by marketing and with the focal point of brand-building. Cooperative progress and benign circulation of such four links as design, production, sales and management should be aimed at. Ten concrete countermeasures are proposed.

articleTitle: Application of engineering methods in art design of software interface
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: Combine key point of theory and methods on software engineering, analyzes general method characteristics of art design on software interface, searching the identity method for solving design problems on different subject. Emphasizes that applying functional art design methods to engineering development process, discussed the application ways of the engineering development methods in software interface of art design. Emphasizes the significance of artistic thought in the software interface design, and points out that logical design process is basic condition & effective ways to achieve the desired interface art design.

articleTitle: Detailed analysis of the human-touch in advertisement design
publicationTitle: 2010 IEEE 11th International Conference on Computer-Aided Industrial Design & Conceptual Design 1
abstract: This paper discusses that in modern society, how to take full advantage of people's emotional appeal. It is only to accurately use and grasp the emotion role in advertising design, people-oriented and resonate, could achieve sales objectives.
